Dear Peter,

We thought you may be interested to hear about this breaking news as Illinois State Representative Tim Ozinga has resigned effective immediately. Ozinga also is leaving his position on the Will County Central Committee. Follow Illinois Review (https://www.illinoisreview.com/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4411a2dba4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) as this story develops.

** Bombshell Resignation Rocks Illinois GOP: Tim Ozinga Vacates Office Effective Immediately! (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/bombshell-resignation-rocks-illinois-gop-tim-ozinga-vacates-office-effective-immediately.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4411a2dba4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/bombshell-resignation-rocks-illinois-gop-tim-ozinga-vacates-office-effective-immediately.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4411a2dba4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

By Illinois Review

The abrupt resignation of State Representative Tim Ozinga has thrown the Illinois GOP into a whirlwind of speculation, concern, and introspection. Ozinga, a figure whose tenure in office has been fraught with controversy, leaves behind a legacy that has sparked heated debates among conservatives in Illinois.

Among the most contentious aspects of his career is his vote to allow non-U.S. citizens the right to arrest American citizens, a move that has been met with strong backlash from conservative circles. This legislation, which enables individuals who are not citizens, including those under DACA, to become police officers, has raised serious questions about the implications for public safety and the sanctity of American citizenship. Critics argue that such a measure dilutes the authority of law enforcement and undermines the very fabric of national sovereignty, setting a precedent that could have far-reaching consequences.

This contentious vote is but one element of a broader narrative of controversy that has defined Ozinga’s time in office. This publication has been instrumental in bringing to light a series of incidents that have cast a shadow over Ozinga’s political career (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/05/tim-ozinga-will-county-gop-central-committee-stunned-when-grassroots-show-up-with-mailers-proving-il-gop-targeted-conservative-candidates-during-april-4th-election.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4411a2dba4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) . One of the most significant of these is the revelation of the Illinois GOP’s involvement in the targeting of conservative candidates during the April 4th 2022 election.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/bombshell-resignation-rocks-illinois-gop-tim-ozinga-vacates-office-effective-immediately.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4411a2dba4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Following Ozinga’s resignation, attention turns to the future of the GOP in Illinois and the process of choosing his successors. Ozinga has indicated a preference for appointing either Michelle Smith or Mark Batinick as the next chair of the Will County Republican organization, a decision that has ignited debate. Each candidate brings their own controversies: Smith is known for her string of electoral defeats, indicating a possible lack of voter appeal and political acumen, while Batinick has supported pandemic-related measures that diverge from the party’s principles on personal freedom and economic liberty, notably his calls for Governor JB Pritzker to enact a statewide mask mandate and to issue a stay-at-home order. These selections highlight the challenges the party faces in finding leaders who can manage the intricacies of modern politics while adhering to conservative values.
CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/04/bombshell-resignation-rocks-illinois-gop-tim-ozinga-vacates-office-effective-immediately.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=4411a2dba4-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_02&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

Within these challenges, the prospect of Patrick Sheehan replacing Ozinga in the state legislature offers a beacon of hope for those in the party longing for a return to core conservative values. However, the true test for the Illinois GOP lies in its ability to reconcile the divergent factions within its ranks, address the concerns raised by Ozinga’s tenure, and chart a path forward that honors the principles of conservatism.

Critics argue that such a measure dilutes the authority of law enforcement and undermines the very fabric of national sovereignty, setting a precedent that could have far-reaching consequences. This contentious vote is but one element of a broader narrative of controversy that has defined Ozinga’s time in office. This publication has been instrumental in bringing to light a series of incidents that have cast a shadow over Ozinga’s political career () . One of the most significant of these is the revelation of the Illinois GOP’s involvement in the targeting of conservative candidates during the April 4th 2022 election. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Following Ozinga’s resignation, attention turns to the future of the GOP in Illinois and the process of choosing his successors. Ozinga has indicated a preference for appointing either Michelle Smith or Mark Batinick as the next chair of the Will County Republican organization, a decision that has ignited debate. Each candidate brings their own controversies: Smith is known for her string of electoral defeats, indicating a possible lack of voter appeal and political acumen, while Batinick has supported pandemic-related measures that diverge from the party’s principles on personal freedom and economic liberty, notably his calls for Governor JB Pritzker to enact a statewide mask mandate and to issue a stay-at-home order. These selections highlight the challenges the party faces in finding leaders who can manage the intricacies of modern politics while adhering to conservative values. CLICK TO READ FULL ARTICLE () Within these challenges, the prospect of Patrick Sheehan replacing Ozinga in the state legislature offers a beacon of hope for those in the party longing for a return to core conservative values. However, the true test for the Illinois GOP lies in its ability to reconcile the divergent factions within its ranks, address the concerns raised by Ozinga’s tenure, and chart a path forward that honors the principles of conservatism. | 🌎 It’s Earth Month! 🌎 Here are **3 THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW** about climate change that underscore our mission at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: **ONE: Rising Temperatures**
The past decade was the warmest on record, with 2023 marking the hottest year _ever_ recorded. Climate experts agree that we're inching dangerously close to the 1.5 degrees Celsius global warming “point of no return.” Crossing that threshold risks serious, irreversible damage to our planet and its fragile ecosystems. **TWO: The Fossil Fuel Industry's Impact**
The fossil fuel industry’s relentless pursuit of profits continues to drive the climate crisis. They threaten our health with deadly extraction and transmission projects, and harm our entire planet with deadly emissions. Despite having known the risks for many decades, they continue to undermine any efforts to reign in these deadly practices and their stranglehold on our political system has allowed them to literally buy more time to continue their global killing spree with impunity. **THREE: Progress and Hope**
In light of the above, it’s understandable that so many people don’t realize how much progress we’ve made in the face of the climate crisis. clean_body: Here is why our mission is so important. | | 🌎 It’s Earth Month! 🌎 Here are 3 THINGS YOU NEED TO KNOW about climate change that underscore our mission at the Jane Fonda Climate PAC: ONE: Rising Temperatures The past decade was the warmest on record, with 2023 marking the hottest year ever recorded. Climate experts agree that we're inching dangerously close to the 1.5 degrees Celsius global warming “point of no return.” Crossing that threshold risks serious, irreversible damage to our planet and its fragile ecosystems. TWO: The Fossil Fuel Industry's Impact The fossil fuel industry’s relentless pursuit of profits continues to drive the climate crisis. They threaten our health with deadly extraction and transmission projects, and harm our entire planet with deadly emissions. Despite having known the risks for many decades, they continue to undermine any efforts to reign in these deadly practices and their stranglehold on our political system has allowed them to literally buy more time to continue their global killing spree with impunity. THREE: Progress and Hope In light of the above, it’s understandable that so many people don’t realize how much progress we’ve made in the face of the climate crisis. While we can’t discount the extent of the harm caused, there have been remarkable strides recently on the demand side — the uptick in solar and wind energy, slowly but surely expanding access to affordable EVs, and more. While we celebrate this progress, we can’t be complacent. These developments show our capacity for change. The momentum to save our planet is building, and you’re a huge part of it! Now, let’s point that momentum even further in the right direction. = | = Jane Fonda Climate PAC | = | = = Follow along: | | ---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. name: Team AOC
subject: Trump: I'm “proudly the person responsible” for ending Roe v. Wade
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Lies about the 2020 election, abortion, and immigration are dominating the airwaves as the election cycle heats up. Just this morning, in a new Truth Social video, Donald Trump pushed even more of these far-right theories to his base.
He claimed that Democrats want to conduct abortions in the ninth month of pregnancy, even “execution after birth.”
And he said that he was “proudly the person responsible” for ending Roe v. Wade.
Trump has done some tap dancing in his stance around abortion, but it’s clear: he will sacrifice the rights, health, and life of anyone with a uterus to get back to the White House.
**We must be ready to fight back.**
[Will you make a contribution of $3 today to power Alexandria's fight against Trump's extremism? Without a concerted effort to combat the MAGA movement, right-wing extremists will endanger marginalized communities and our democracy itself.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240408.u5Lbpg&refcode=em20240408-6159-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6159%2E2526796%2EPwccNW)
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240408.u5Lbpg&refcode=em20240408-6159-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6159%2E2526796%2EPwccNW)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240408.u5Lbpg&refcode=em20240408-6159-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=6159%2E2526796%2EPwccNW)**
Trump has said that abortion rights should be left to individual states to decide. If you want to get a glimpse into what a second Trump term would mean, just take a look at Texas:
In West Texas, some counties have successfully banned people seeking an abortion from traveling on certain roads, or through certain cities, in order to reach neighboring states where abortion access is legally protected.
The Texas Attorney General is going to extreme lengths to enforce the state's six-week abortion ban — threatening hospitals, doctors, and other judges with legal action if they perform or grant legal access to an abortion. The Texas AG is also encouraging private citizens to help enforce the ban by suing anyone who ‘aids and abets’ an abortion.
This is what the MAGA movement wants more of. **We cannot let that happen.**
[Will you chip in $3 today to help power our grassroots campaign for progress against the bigotry of the MAGA movement?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240408.u5Lbpg&refcode=em20240408-6159-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=6159%2E2526796%2EPwccNW)

From all of us here on the campaign, we thank you for your support.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

subject: I’m up against a well-funded MAGA candidate
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
We have seven months to go until Election Day, and my MAGA opponent has already raised more than half a million dollars(!) . The more I think about it, the more concerning this news becomes.
It’s one thing to ignore a fringe candidate because his extreme views are beyond reasonable discussion. Fox News already gives these guys a 24/7 platform to spew whatever nonsense is on their minds – I certainly don’t need to add to the free press.
But it’s another thing when your Trump-idolizing opponent is building up a sizable war chest of cash in a sincere effort to turn our district red.
And it’s not just my seat. Thanks to Donald Trump’s hold over the Republican Party, Democrats all across the country are facing challenges from out-of-touch extremists just like Bill Wells.
I know my constituents, and I know they want representation rooted in integrity, policy backed by science, and inclusive, thoughtful leadership.
But as we look around at what’s happening in our country, it’s clear we need to make a strong statement this November. We need to reject extremism and division – and send a message that you can’t run on a platform of bigotry and conspiracy theories and still win.
To do that, Democrats have to step up our fundraising efforts.
Defeating my opponent and helping other Democrats win in November isn’t going to come easy, or cheap. So I’m asking directly for your support – will you consider chipping in whatever amount is meaningful to you? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
I know my opponent’s extreme views don’t align with the values of this district or the American people. He opposes abortion under all circumstances, wants to overturn marriage equality, and thinks climate change is a hoax used to control people.
But we can’t ignore the signs that Donald Trump, his acolytes, and his entire brand of politics have a real shot at winning again in 2024.
Despite attempting to overturn the 2020 election, leading an insurrection on January 6, 2021, and currently facing 91 felony counts, Trump still has a hold on the American public. That’s why national Republicans are throwing money at fringe candidates all over the country, including my opponent.
Fighting back against Trumpism and MAGA candidates is going to take ALL of us making a concerted effort every day between now and November.
I need your help – can you donate any amount to help us boost our fundraising numbers? Click here to pitch in online. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you so much for your support.
-Sara

Congresswoman Sara Jacobs
California’s 51st District

name: Hillsdale College via Your America News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32827%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=1oIk3nzX%2blJwtwXb1hRvLg&sysid=1) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32828%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jQ4DIb%2bwRVWBYPgO3sHqNg&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c32828%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jQ4DIb%2bwRVWBYPgO3sHqNg&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

name: Hillsdale College via American Briefing
subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from American Briefing is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zp33fiq9ai6ta4b3tcnei5j2r1nk1386p8sj91mo_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdimepr2cph2bs) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zt8e4go4a9vjkmkgnudtggrr71t171q4iga6aklg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdimepr2cph2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z4rvqki374khu5avtir3qughvsplel97mu286heo_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdimepr2cph2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zdg9ndfnnvb0o1h2o1blbn2g5gn6db0bgcgic8mg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdhm0ob2cph2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: President Trump’s announcement to pro-lifers
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

As you may have heard, President Donald Trump just announced his plans on dealing with abortion if elected President.

In his video to the Pro-Life Movement, he began his remarks on abortion by celebrating “the ultimate joy in life” which are children and family.

Needless to say, this kind of love and support for the bedrock of society – the family – would be a welcome change in the White House, as President Biden and his pro-abortion puppets want nothing but more dead preborn boys and girls.

But it’s actually what President Trump didn’t pledge to do that was a major sigh of relief for me – and proved that your voices make a difference.

You see, President Trump did not come out in support of a divisive, national late-term limit on abortion as many were predicting.

Make no mistake – I certainly would have preferred that the President would have announced his support for a federal Life at Conception Law to abolish ALL abortion nationwide.

And I’m going to keep fighting for this alongside you and the rest of the young people we are mobilizing in the Pro-Life Generation as long as I have life in my body.

But had the President supported a 15-week abortion limit (as some wanted), passing Heartbeat Prevention Laws and Life at Conception Laws at the state level would have been increasingly difficult, if President Trump were elected.

State legislators would have simply told us, “The President supports a 15-week abortion limit. So do I.”

And that would be it.

Since these 15-week abortion limits do little but allow 94%+ of abortions to continue, this would be a travesty.

A federal law wouldn’t pass as we still lack 60 votes in the U.S. Senate. And state-level restrictions would all but stop.

And more babies would be killed.

Thankfully, President Trump did hear our voices.

Of course, we still need to do more to ensure he understands that abortion is indeed a federal issue that can ultimately only be solved by Congress.

I’m going to continue depending on your help for that.

To read my thoughts on what President Trump so do next to protect precious babies from abortion, please check out my op-ed in Townhall yesterday: https://townhall.com/kristanhawkins [https://townhall.com/columnists/kristanhawkins/2024/04/07/what-the-pro-life-generation-hopes-president-trump-will-commit-to-on-the-human-rights-issue-of-our-day-n2637459].

Or watch my interview today on Charlie Kirk’s show: https://rumble.com/trumpsabortiontake [https://rumble.com/v4o87vu-trumps-abortion-take-musk-vs.-brazil-peter-pan-syndrome-kelly-hawkins-shrie.html].

Thank you for everything you do for Life, including your unwavering support for our mission.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins

President, Students for Life Action

| Friends, The April 8 midnight deadline has passed. Governor Youngkin has set the new record, vetoing more bills in one year than any other Virginia governor, at 153 vetoes out of 1,046 bills. The Governor has soundly rejected the Democrat's insane authoritarian agenda that raises taxes on every Virginian.
Governor Youngkin has offered 233 amendments to bills passed by the Democrat controlled General Assembly and signed 777 bills into law.
Here is the final list of bills Governor Youngkin has either signed into law, vetoed or amended. If you want more detail about a particular bill, just click on the tab for veto, sign or amend.
The Virginia General Assembly will reconvene on Wednesday, April 17 for consideration of the Governor's amendments and vetoes. With only a one member majority in each house, it is unlikely that the Democrats will be able to override any of Governor Youngkin's vetoes.
Included in this weekly newsletter is a list of important dates for upcoming primaries and elections. Please mark your calendar.

body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Old Glory Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7gmPefPGGUDIcxpKOTtdpA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn962YP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDQwOVcDc3BjQgpmEIUOFWZ7MB_VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email—I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty—including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7gmPefPGGUDIcxpKOTtdpA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn962YP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDQwOVcDc3BjQgpmEIUOFWZ7MB_VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights—to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more—are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight—in which Hillsdale College is a leader—is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** —on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.—who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/7gmPefPGGUDIcxpKOTtdpA~~/AARclAA~/RgRn962YP0SsaHR0cHM6Ly9scC5oaWxsc2RhbGUuZWR1L2RlcGFydG1lbnQtb2YtanVzdGljZS1zdXJ2ZXkvP3NjPTAxMDQwTjAyNDJMMEFET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1kb2pzdXJ2ZXkmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9U0FMX1BBLU9HVC0yMDI0MDQwOVcDc3BjQgpmEIUOFWZ7MB_VUhRkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbVgEAAAAAA~~)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

## Solar Eclipse Draws Millions, Makes Billions
Millions of eclipse chasers gathered across North America Monday to view a rare total solar eclipse. [Photos are here](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsUD2P5CAU-zWkYwQ8PpIixa1WuWqvvXLE8l4GTiREwE60__6UqbeyZFu27L8f9w-fctoff_xGc1_L3YeennTXfOJK3_WA80qkCAaapZPK2smBGeIMzoAAB86g1KMTBkYI5NyEiAK9GdKshNJCi0lMxsJ4C9OI4tNalBjWNUimBWHqpd7-lbT3SGv-Lk-qt1C2Ic-x96Mx-MXUwtRynudta_ulMbXQzr8aU8tO5wWlR6pMLa1kXzmFnI5G_KrnRyy9NL7WsvEeiR--R15W3kv3OfVv7nfklBudkSrxtL9cX_yK9ZW_vckcf2-JwVJCQgbvWyN87P2IWJmy4fkiR-GMt9JbNKBHaQgwWCOtV59WhjUwZSkxeJcw1BmPM-WcmnVMi8fmU34t7j_d_z8AAP__G6CD8g). The eclipse's path of totality was measured at more than 100 miles wide and was first visible on Mexico's Pacific coast before moving northeast through the U.S. and into Canada. Spectators flocking to prime viewing spots caused [reported traffic crashes and road delays](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO8yAQhJ8Gd1iACQ4FxR_9cpdrU1obWOI9YWMBFytvf0rqq2Y0I41G3-06X4ESbY8vWNG1mGfwjZ44a2650rPugouICocOnRylMsaOw6lb3H2MMgQzBh8wmrMFfbJ3lAAy2hGt78gpobTQwgp7MsO59_YcxN2YIIOP0UumBQZqufTfmba2YEyv_MTS-7x2yS2t7ZUN_5iamJqO4-jXur07pibc-E9latrweMvHw4IQeI685gSFo0-0V-Q5RvIEqfKCey6NtwLviPsCdcHKYQs8YILXZ6Twy0Wmxd5eTA20wgPZ8F92xYX9oJSompFp8ViB0udn-wvabwAAAP__ZcVv8A) across the country. The airline industry also experienced the effects of solar eclipse enthusiasts. Regional airports reported increased airplane traffic that turned runways into parking lots. Delta Air Lines [used the phenomenon as a marketing too](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2O6yAQRp8Gd1h4jAkUFLdxl9tuaWF-4lkNwQIUa99-ldTbfM0nnSOdr_t2d0j4fPx3OdqeyuZ8x1fcJDcc5CaHYFOMEOch2uk2gVLmNi_DYfW8yyU5SGaCoBYAvQiljd4nsytt1IAWBEghhRFmUbMevdFB7EqFKfiU_MSkiAF7qeN3wWc_YqKf8op19CUPZI_ez8bmfwxWBut1XaN_7v59MljfaAar-IxmsLZCrvLoCc8WeSJ8HL3xdrmaecuOiDusZ6m9jUfPNFQbzguJsKkbk-KRHdJH3P-q8BsAAP__8ZNdIA)l and sold flights so passengers could view it from the sky. Economists have estimated that the eclipse could have an [economic impact of $6 billion](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOrSAURb8GOgwCohQUr7G7r53SIBz0TBCMkGvu30-cerq9s4qVrK_X8nKYMG__3QG2xbI43_ANi2KGCbUoGmwEECAp2H7shdZmlAPdrXHgwMRxktxxo70Zhjh5KWWQQ9RKULSCC8UVN9wMWk6dN1Pgq9ahDz5G3xPFIWArV_ddMLcdYvqUN1ydLwdNdm_trET-I2ImYr7vu_NrzXDXhxMxP5OIuZbkLgY-4VmBufPCxCYGvuRyfFg9IQfMG1tLOZhmK6aEJRMx08uG835u1SNRfDscpl91-6vDTwAAAP__P15gLg) thanks to increased spending on hotels, restaurants, and travel across the country.
## Biden Takes Second Shot at Loan Forgiveness
President Biden announced plans Monday to allow [up to 30 million Americans](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL2OozAURp_GdBf5LwYKik1Bl5W22SmRg6_DnRg7g02svP0oU0_1Sd9pjs7HZb5YChRvf-2GY_FptkuhJ84aBpB61o0bPaJE1eAoOiGNGTp1atbR9LZ3WkuFCnvZmeFqrVDCcO-UFdo1NEouNdd84MPJqL5dht7xqzFOuMX7RTDN0VFJe_uZKJYVfXilJ-7tkrYmjGspj8zUHyYnJqdaa7vl-GZMThjhyExOW4r4eq_d71jez5UcRsgQsUIuh8NYICQbwaf9Rk-MmDM8go1Q1wRfhw3kCTPY6GBNFahATUdwUNN-Z3KyO5zPIvh__02zj-5RKQTKpmOa3zZL4Ue2_FbuOwAA___JR3Hm) another shot at federal student-loan debt forgiveness, despite knowing the plan would quickly be challenged by Republicans in court. Last year, the Supreme Court struck down Biden's original plan to cancel up to $20,000 in debt for about 43 million eligible borrowers. Biden has used workarounds to continue forgiving certain types of student debt since then. The administration's latest actions, taken together, will eliminate accrued interest [for 23 million borrowers](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLFuwyAURb8Gb1iAMZiBoYu3dO1oYXhOXoXBAhwrf1-lY9Xx3rMcna_bcnMYMd0_3Q62bXlxvuETFkkNFXKRXbAbgIChA8s1F0oZPYzdw04raC45M0EIPq4rMFDAghmV194p1qEVTEgmmWFmVMPUezMFtioVePDb5jmRDAK2XPrvjKk9YIuv_ITS-7x30T5aOyoZPoiYiZiv6-rT6hNc9c2JmI8csaGvRMz1PArsQH0-S_u7aTkj0BUDpEprOwOkRmN2iW653PEJCWqlR3wfBYN70eKT02rSsis2HBfGiFVpItl9dxh_9dp_rX4CAAD__3-bbpA), cancel the full amount of student debt for more than 4 million borrowers, and provide at least $5,000 in debt relief to more than 10 million others.
## UConn Beats Purdue for NCAA Men's Title
The University of Connecticut dominated Purdue [in a 75-60 victory](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLHSnSAQhZ8Gu72DyOVqYZHG7k-b0lmWVcmP4ADq5O0zpk5_5pzzfb--5i_0wcf1J-481iXNSNVfPGsYQOlZN25cmBV3DY_tp1XGDJ_u3Wwj9jS8seslG23sW7UdmsVZ3Q2EuLBt_Kik0lLLQQ5v0_UvGnonrTGudbQs1Aot2fma8ut38rFuvIQ_6eL8orQ3YdxqPYrofgg1CTXd9_0iW8qRci1PQqiJUgi8Mlgs31wthiDUFPkuQk3PNkRCBNpwP3yKZfMHrLgzBH8xnIfDygVOSjHCVeA4szsZCqXMsGOmDXZ0kUsBm5G-uQI993BloaanQ6ipyaM7bh-CL-YjtFx39OEfQP2fzb8BAAD__0_berI) Monday night, making UConn the new 2024 NCAA men's college champions. With Monday's win, UConn became the first team to win back-to-back championships in men's basketball since the Florida Gators in 2006-07. subject: Justice, weaponized
body:
Please particpate in this survey on the Department of Justice.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9f70a0c57bc0464ab82a188e5b6c36dc&_e=Hb8A_0XpDg9BkboB4e5SoyZtjg00AWtWyOidtRGxeSrwhSiBxUdcXoQ77N0SezZpyBfCyD9pCugvQjEghxk1-_mvTMoT2tjyf6O0o3ByQizFf8CUc-lSSxaduHpBG2w4jMHFrraypXo1n79y8zX4vpGvO3oLbf7f-Lj8ihenYVAv61FoNeLqUYk9VHNICkoQG1B6ux8AxJ9LfSu7SyoQ6lPG2EKod9D1RT2dv3uvpk1CWomI1pQHP8uJjUekWrUKunZ4VyF_dz2Dwdn_O7cQNirvZTDZ3GG7kGQ5mq6LKJMjvQVHsspqujtxs0JZiSFw6dVZ4uA6TxP7It7-eC-fa6_Gc2S12c3WP_XcU3iHZZY1MPR5lFsbTzd0LpF3dNCjWCCcpWhSmctkdiYe7AeYyQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9f70a0c57bc0464ab82a188e5b6c36dc&_e=Hb8A_0XpDg9BkboB4e5SoyZtjg00AWtWyOidtRGxeSrwhSiBxUdcXoQ77N0SezZpyBfCyD9pCugvQjEghxk1-_mvTMoT2tjyf6O0o3ByQizFf8CUc-lSSxaduHpBG2w4jMHFrraypXo1n79y8zX4vpGvO3oLbf7f-Lj8ihenYVAv61FoNeLqUYk9VHNICkoQG1B6ux8AxJ9LfSu7SyoQ6lPG2EKod9D1RT2dv3uvpk1CWomI1pQHP8uJjUekWrUKaEGNT26yyuTEYPlE6pIeKqEELu_MkmEq1Jp2D95FlqRDnbY34gT5XsTq8evPKiPP0Q8ESm4JyCyK2L4A78bUXsTDku8VndfPJ6WkGpmUx72ONjc2QiK3sT1p0PtYSvak0BrWkyOmignoiFl7BZBrTw%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=9f70a0c57bc0464ab82a188e5b6c36dc&_e=Hb8A_0XpDg9BkboB4e5SoyZtjg00AWtWyOidtRGxeSrwhSiBxUdcXoQ77N0SezZpyBfCyD9pCugvQjEghxk1-_mvTMoT2tjyf6O0o3ByQizFf8CUc-lSSxaduHpBG2w4jMHFrraypXo1n79y8zX4vpGvO3oLbf7f-Lj8ihenYVAv61FoNeLqUYk9VHNICkoQG1B6ux8AxJ9LfSu7SyoQ6lPG2EKod9D1RT2dv3uvpk1CWomI1pQHP8uJjUekWrUKMV4sdQIcW7khTy-HKP-Cf36qB5YfXV-N7dR9aACQPOKrTYIAd3ECyE1h3_5TDrj7NnLObqIENvxv0IB2BzdQwRowovtDNUTcqFp0d41uPRX0J6DNZ6M7x8HW5fsuXcGgYgUE1BeWyUMDsCO_m5ckmg%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

| **** **The question of the day is _" Will Chuck Schumer actually hold an impeachment trial for Alejandro Mayorkas?"_**
The House is sending two impeachment charges tomorrow, April 10, 2024, to Chuck Schumer, the Majority Leader in the Senate, who, in turn, decided to schedule the trial for the next day, Thursday, April 11th.
Yes, you read that right. Chuck Schumer scheduled the impeachment trial for the same day the Senate would receive the articles of impeachment. Or is it more like, "trial?"However, each senator will be sworn in as jurors before anything can happen. Once they are sworn in, Democrats can either act on the side of justice and truth or they can protect their buddy.
Democrats don't have to hold a trial on the Senate floor once everyone is sworn in. They can instead make a motion to table the charges, to move them to a committee (where they would likely die).
There is little hope that Schumer will actually allow a trial to happen. The most likely scenario is that the charges will be tabled completely or moved into a committee to disappear _forever_.**** ****[****](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794798062d6/1edb9794784bf44f) **** ************

**
**We know the evidence against Mayorkas is overwhelming, which is why Democrats will try to skirt a trial, but every Senator has a duty and obligation to the constitution to hear the charges. Americans deserve the chance to hold Mayorkas accountable for his extreme dereliction of duty regarding our wide open border.

Dear
Friend,

While we
see it most often among young people, a socialist way of thinking
is spreading broadly across the U.S. and around the world.

It is
critical to keep the facts, history, and results of both
Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism at the forefront of the
national conversation.

That's
why I'm sending you this email today. I would like to personally
invite you to watch the new Hoover Institution video lecture,
Socialism vs. Capitalism for free.

You can
sign up for this four-chapter lecture here:
https://resources.hoover.org/socialism-vs-capitalism-course-signup/

This
lecture is from Hoover's exclusive Policy Bootcamp and is led by
Peter Berkowitz-a Senior Fellow at Hoover who served in teh
previous administration as U.S. State Department Director of
Policy Planning.

Peter is
an academic expert on political philosophy, ranging from
constitutional conservatism to progressivism. Inside this lecture
he'll give you a deeper understanding of:

Distinctions between capitalism and socialism

Common criticisms of both economic systems

Disagreement between Karl Marx and John Locke regarding property
rights

Centralized economic planning and its failures

You
can activate your free online lecture right now by using this
secure link:
https://resources.hoover.org/socialism-vs-capitalism-course-signup/

Thank
you,
Greg

| Peter, **Republicans know they have a problem with young voters.** It’s why they’ve spent so much time and effort trying to stop us from voting, whether it’s through restrictive voting laws designed to stop college students from casting ballots or their outrageous proposals to raise the voting age. But they’re starting to wake up to the fact that whether they like it or not, young people will vote if they’re motivated to turn out. **So the GOP is changing tactics.** ALEC Action — the campaign arm of the American Legislative Exchange Council, which pushes for the passage of ultra-right-wing bills in state legislatures across the country — is teaming up with Run GenZ to boost young “conservatives” who are running for office. **Seem like a familiar strategy?_We thought so too._ [Will you split $25 or any amount you can between Leaders We Deserve and Blue Amp Action? Every donation helps us double down on our strategy to elect _progressive_ young leaders instead.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5ce77d0d-c216-4e59-b27b-4ea27b1dc86b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[ ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T200d8620-b7ca-40bd-a466-be8e31567d46/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) But let’s be real for a second. The fact that the Republican Party is nearly entirely dominated by old, out-of-touch white dudes isn’t the real source of their problem with young voters (though it certainly doesn’t help). **Republicans have a young voter problem because of their platform.** Young people today have grown up amidst near-constant mass shootings across the country, including in our schools. We see the evidence of a changing climate before our very eyes, and we know the impact it could have on our future. But despite all this, Republicans have consistently fought to make it _easier_ to access **dangerous guns** and stood in the way of common-sense gun safety laws that could keep young people safe in school. And they continue to deny the reality of climate change in the face of overwhelming evidence. Plus, while young people today are more pro-choice and pro-equality than ever, Republicans across the country have made it their mission to chip away at **LGBTQ rights** and pass draconian **abortion bans** , often with no exceptions whatsoever. So MAGA is welcome to put a fresh young face on their horrible old policies — but that won’t change the fact that young voters are overwhelmingly opposed to their agenda. **In contrast, Leaders We Deserve is working to elect young leaders who will fight _for_ young peoples’ priorities, not against them. But we’re a grassroots organization that takes no corporate funding, so we’re counting on your support to do it.** [**If you want to expose the GOP's latest astroturfed effort to target young people as the sham it is, split $25 or anything you can right now to help us elect the leaders we really deserve on Election Day:**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T69898d7f-2ac3-4681-a82c-c9151e4d1471/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thanks for your support, David Hogg President & Co-founder, Leaders We Deserve

No matter what they say in public, we know that the MAGA-right and Republican politicians nationwide are hellbent on a national abortion ban.

The Arizona Supreme Court will issue a ruling on a Civil War-era law that would force a near-total ban on abortion statewide.
It should never have come this far. But thanks to people like Kari Lake, this is where we are. She called this Civil War-era abortion ban a “great law” and has called abortion “the ultimate sin.”

The only way that we can prevent that ban is to hold the Senate, take back the House, and defeat Donald Trump.

name: Bill Spadea
subject: The future of our transportation
body:
In Trenton, there's chatter about raising taxes yet again to fund NJ Transit, without a whisper about efficiency or scrutinizing our bloated
|
---
| Peter, Bill Spadea here, and today I want to address an issue that's as pressing as it gets for us here in the Garden State: the future of our transportation infrastructure. With New Jersey having the highest business taxes in the nation, you might think the only way out of any fiscal jam is to hike taxes even higher... **_But that's a myth I'm ready to debunk._** In Trenton, there's chatter about raising taxes yet again to fund NJ Transit, without a whisper about efficiency or scrutinizing our bloated state budget. It's the same old song from the same career politicians who seem more interested in maintaining their titles than serving their constituents.
---
|
---
But here's the truth – while investing in New Jersey's transportation infrastructure is crucial, raising taxes is NOT the only solution. **It's possible to fund necessary improvements without further burdening New Jerseyans with additional taxes.**
---
| **My plan doesn't just aim to avoid tax increases; it's about streamlining processes, cutting through bureaucratic red tape, and reallocating funds from wasteful programs to where they're genuinely needed****– in our roads, bridges, and public transportation systems.** It's about making New Jersey more attractive for businesses and residents alike, creating jobs, and ensuring our state remains a competitive place to live and work. **The upcoming weeks will see me rolling out specific proposals to Restore Affordability to New Jersey.** From reining in the DEP and DOT bureaucracies to redirecting funds toward our failing infrastructure, I'm committed to showing that there's a better way. **_As we push forward with these common-sense solutions, your support is more crucial than ever._** Becoming a member of the Common Sense Club isn't just a way to stand with me; it's an active step towards fostering a safer, more prosperous future for New Jersey. Our club is dedicated to advocating for policies that make sense for our communities and our economy. By joining, you'll be part of a collective effort to bring about real, positive change in our state.
**If you're not already a member,** [**click here to learn more and join us today.**](https://xtz223.keap-link020.com/v2/click/f8b41ebeb81201a03525470ef5ec56d8/eJyNkE0LgkAURf_LW5sfU0K4i5AQzUXUOgZ95ZSOw_TMLPzvTRauClrfc8_jvgcQSi4pyiGAG90Zm4IFGjOhBEpa1pJ4NqTMn3lTz4JSyPNK142C4PG1PAJDy3OZBdQpNMh2s1jGUbraJ1EaG1JxbW7853H9-egJ14sogb7_KcZKUHg17gsEpBt8LcqFWUU7XRq-IFKXwHHatrVPtZBU4EEcC2Ium9lZXTlYcVFOXpGxcaVQ5p9XxNi9nf0TG1Rm7A==) Thank you for standing with us. It's time to roll up our sleeves and get to work on making New Jersey the state we know it can be. Best, Bill Spadea

It's the same old song from the same career politicians who seem more interested in maintaining their titles than serving their constituents. | But here's the truth – while investing in New Jersey's transportation infrastructure is crucial, raising taxes is NOT the only solution. It's possible to fund necessary improvements without further burdening New Jerseyans with additional taxes. | My plan doesn't just aim to avoid tax increases; it's about streamlining processes, cutting through bureaucratic red tape, and reallocating funds from wasteful programs to where they're genuinely needed– in our roads, bridges, and public transportation systems. It's about making New Jersey more attractive for businesses and residents alike, creating jobs, and ensuring our state remains a competitive place to live and work. The upcoming weeks will see me rolling out specific proposals to Restore Affordability to New Jersey. From reining in the DEP and DOT bureaucracies to redirecting funds toward our failing infrastructure, I'm committed to showing that there's a better way. As we push forward with these common-sense solutions, your support is more crucial than ever. Becoming a member of the Common Sense Club isn't just a way to stand with me; it's an active step towards fostering a safer, more prosperous future for New Jersey. Our club is dedicated to advocating for policies that make sense for our communities and our economy. By joining, you'll be part of a collective effort to bring about real, positive change in our state. If you're not already a member, == Thank you for standing with us. It's time to roll up our sleeves and get to work on making New Jersey the state we know it can be. Best, Bill Spadea | | Common Sense Club 165 Route 35 Red Bank, New Jersey 07701 United States

Certificate of Need (CON) laws are regulations that require healthcare providers to obtain permission from a state regulatory board before building new facilities or expanding existing ones. These laws, which were first enacted in the 1960s, were intended to control healthcare costs and improve access to care. However, they have been a subject of debate in recent years, with some arguing that they limit competition and hinder access to care, while others believe they are necessary to ensure the quality and efficiency of healthcare services. In this blog post, we will provide a comprehensive overview of CON laws, their history, and the arguments for and against them.
History of Certificate of Need Laws:
CON laws were first introduced in New York in 1964 as a way to control healthcare costs by preventing the duplication of services and ensuring that new facilities were only built when there was a demonstrated need for them. By the 1970s, most states had enacted some form of CON regulation, and in 1974, the federal government passed the National Health Planning and Resources Development Act, which required states to establish CON programs in order to receive federal funding for healthcare. However, in 1987, the federal government repealed this mandate, and many states began to scale back or repeal their CON laws.
Arguments for Certificate of Need Laws:
Proponents of CON laws argue that they are necessary to control healthcare costs and ensure that healthcare resources are distributed efficiently. They contend that without CON regulations, healthcare providers would engage in a "medical arms race," building new facilities and purchasing expensive equipment in order to attract patients, even if there is no demonstrated need for these services. This, in turn, would drive up healthcare costs and make it more difficult for low-income and rural residents to access care.
Arguments against Certificate of Need Laws:
One of the main arguments against CON laws is that they limit competition and restrict the supply of healthcare services. By requiring providers to obtain permission from a state board before building new facilities or expanding existing ones, CON laws can create barriers to entry for new providers, which can stifle innovation and prevent the development of new and more efficient models of care.
Another argument against CON laws is that they can lead to higher healthcare costs. By limiting the supply of healthcare services, CON laws can create monopolies or oligopolies, which can drive up prices and make it more difficult for patients to access care.
There is also evidence to suggest that CON laws have not been effective in achieving their stated goals. Studies have shown that CON states have fewer hospitals, nursing homes, and other healthcare facilities per capita than non-CON states, and that residents of CON states are more likely to leave their counties to obtain care.
Certificate of Need laws limit competition, restrict the supply of healthcare services, and can lead to higher costs and reduced access to care. Mississippi has refused to repeal its CON laws because legislators have bowed to large healthcare providers who use these laws to limit competition.
If Mississippians wants better healthcare then its time we make better decisions.

name: Andy Kim
subject: The suit I wore
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Defeat Republicans PAC (www
body:
|
---
Peter,

Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later.

When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol’s rotunda floor on January 6.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82657522/465975033/-285836992?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240409_1_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIxNDQ3ZTBmLTc4ZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=phpbW2wfyWI-QmrfVzoh0o-jh2rjcLsbF_lrBAgQzXA=)
_Holding my bright blue suit, perhaps for the last time, before I donated it to the Smithsonian._
Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I‘d never wear it again.

**But the story of January 6 isn’t just about violence, insurrection, and trauma.** Like our country’s story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw.

I still cherish every single one.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82657523/465975034/-285836992?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240409_1_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIxNDQ3ZTBmLTc4ZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=phpbW2wfyWI-QmrfVzoh0o-jh2rjcLsbF_lrBAgQzXA=)
_I never imagined that something as simple and reflexive as cleaning up a mess I saw could become inspirational to those like the artist who sent me this wonderful illustration._
Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together.

Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground.

**That common ground is closer than you might realize, Peter.**

I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in DC, the in-fighting within the GOP’s own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It’s a mess, for sure -- and it’s all of ours to clean up together.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82657524/465975035/-285836992?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240409_1_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIxNDQ3ZTBmLTc4ZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=phpbW2wfyWI-QmrfVzoh0o-jh2rjcLsbF_lrBAgQzXA=)
I’m raising my two Jersey boys in the same community that welcomed my parents from South Korea. Everything I have done in Congress is to keep the promise I made to help build them a better world than the one we inherited —**and now, I am running for U.S. Senate to bring that same integrity and an emphasis on putting people first.**

That’s why the movement we’re building is focused on civility and service, starting in the same New Jersey community that raised me and stretching out to every corner of our country.

[I’m ready to help bring our country together and fix what’s broken. That’s why I’m running for Senate to restore integrity and honor to our government and I’m humbly asking you to join me in this cause. Can I count on you to split a donation between my campaign and Defeat Republicans?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82657525/465975036/-285836992?refcode=DR_SPLIT_FR_90DO_240409_1_1&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNi8xLzg1ODM1IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIxNDQ3ZTBmLTc4ZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=phpbW2wfyWI-QmrfVzoh0o-jh2rjcLsbF_lrBAgQzXA=)

clean_body: | Peter, Believe it or not, I found this suit on the sale rack at J. Crew, not long after the 2020 election. I liked the bold blue color and thought I might wear it to the inauguration a few weeks later. When I donated it to the Smithsonian, the knees were dusted with dirt from the night I spent cleaning trash off of the Capitol’s rotunda floor on January 6. = Holding my bright blue suit, perhaps for the last time, before I donated it to the Smithsonian. Honestly, I had seriously considered throwing the suit away until the Smithsonian called. That day still brings such terrible memories for me; I knew I‘d never wear it again. But the story of January 6 isn’t just about violence, insurrection, and trauma. Like our country’s story, that day ended full of hope, resilience, civility, and service. Even the simple step I took to help clean up that trash the insurrectionists left behind sparked something much more significant. In the weeks that followed, I received thousands of cards and letters from folks across the country who were inspired or comforted by what they saw. I still cherish every single one. = I never imagined that something as simple and reflexive as cleaning up a mess I saw could become inspirational to those like the artist who sent me this wonderful illustration. Those cards remind me how strong this country is, and how strong we can be when we come together. Right now, our partisan divide can seem so deep that it threatens to tear us apart. We saw it on full display on January 6, and we must ensure nothing like that ever happens again. That means working with Congress to protect our Capitol, but it also means all of us working together to find common ground. That common ground is closer than you might realize, Peter. I can clearly see the disconnect between the partisan wars being waged in DC, the in-fighting within the GOP’s own party, and the priorities of my friends and neighbors in New Jersey. We are honestly all just exhausted by the endless cycles of misinformation and outrage. It’s a mess, for sure -- and it’s all of ours to clean up together. = I’m raising my two Jersey boys in the same community that welcomed my parents from South Korea. Everything I have done in Congress is to keep the promise I made to help build them a better world than the one we inherited —and now, I am running for U.S. Senate to bring that same integrity and an emphasis on putting people first. That’s why the movement we’re building is focused on civility and service, starting in the same New Jersey community that raised me and stretching out to every corner of our country. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will process immediately by clicking a button below. | = = = = More soon, Andy Defeat Republicans | Paid for by Defeat Republicans PAC (www.DefeatRepublicans.org) and not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. We can’t afford to lose any ground to the right-wing at a moment like this. | | | Peter, Over the last few years we’ve been able to help elect a growing, dynamic group of working families champions to Congress. These victories — some against all odds — have built up our governing power as a movement and have had a real impact on people’s lives. **But this power that we are building together has not gone unnoticed.** And over the next few weeks, some of our strongest champions in Congress will face their biggest challenges yet. From now through November, the Working Families Party and our champions in Congress are going to face a barrage of attacks from Republican megadonors and their allies who have planned to spend _more than $100 million_ in _Democratic primaries_ to tear down what we are building — and ultimately to put MAGA back in full control of Congress and the White House. clean_body: We can’t afford to lose any ground to the right-wing at a moment like this. | | | Peter, Over the last few years we’ve been able to help elect a growing, dynamic group of working families champions to Congress. These victories — some against all odds — have built up our governing power as a movement and have had a real impact on people’s lives. But this power that we are building together has not gone unnoticed. And over the next few weeks, some of our strongest champions in Congress will face their biggest challenges yet. From now through November, the Working Families Party and our champions in Congress are going to face a barrage of attacks from Republican megadonors and their allies who have planned to spend more than $100 million in Democratic primaries to tear down what we are building — and ultimately to put MAGA back in full control of Congress and the White House. We can’t afford to lose any ground to the right-wing at a moment like this. That’s why, this Thursday, we are joining members of the Squad and allies for a special livestream event to kick off our efforts to defend the progress we’ve fought so hard to win. Can’t make it? On Thursday’s livestream, you’ll get to hear directly from Rep. Summer Lee, WFP National Director Maurice Mitchell, and other special guests — and learn more about how you can plug in to our efforts to Protect the Squad in the coming weeks and months. Hi, it’s Sen. Brad Pfaff, and I’m reaching out to tell you some big news.
Now that the legislative session is over, my reelection campaign is officially underway!
For the past 3 years, I’ve had the great honor of working for the people of District 32 and I’m so proud of everything I’ve been able to accomplish with your support.
I’m about to get into the issues that I want to tackle in the next few years, but if you’re busy and can’t stay that long, do you think you can make a contribution of any amount to help my people–powered campaign start off on the right foot? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240409_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]
RE-ELECT BRAD [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pfaff-email?refcode=20240409_em_fr_b1_BP_NGP]

During my public service career, I’ve been a constant and tireless champion for small farmers and working Wisconsinites.
However, the hard work is far from over.
There’s a lot more I want to do to make Wisconsin a better home for all, including 1️⃣ protecting reproductive rights for all Wisconsinites, 2️⃣ fighting for affordable childcare for Wisconsin families, and 3️⃣ lowering the cost of groceries and prescription drugs.
And I want to let you in on a secret. Achieving all of this and more is possible with your support.
It’s going to be all hands on deck for the next few months because my GOP opponent will be working just as hard to unseat me and undo all the progress we’ve made so far. There’s a lot at stake in this election, and I’m counting on your grassroots support to make my reelection campaign a success – will you join my team with a donation of $10 or $20 today? Thank you,
Sen. Brad Pfaff
Brad Pfaff is a proud son of the rolling hills, coulees, and valleys of northern La Crosse County where he was raised on his family's dairy farm. # **FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE - April 9, 2024**
Tippah County, Mississippi - The Mississippi Republican Party successfully held conventions across the state on Saturday, April 6, 2024. The conventions saw the participation of delegates from various precincts who convened at 10:00 AM to elect delegates for the county conventions held at 3:00 PM.
In Tippah County, the Republican convention took place at the county courthouse, where delegates elected a new executive committee and officers. These individuals are now responsible for upholding and promoting the party's principles and values in local government for the next four years.
The newly elected officers of the Tippah County Republican Party are:
Dana Criswell - Chair
Jim Gunter - Vice Chair
Laquita Wilkerson - Secretary
Following the convention, newly elected Chairman Dana Criswell expressed his enthusiasm about working with the people of Tippah County, stating:
> > "I am excited about the opportunity to work with the people of Tippah County as we promote the principles and values that make our state great. Over the next four years, the Tippah County Republican Party will demonstrate to the people of our county that the Republican Party has the answers that can best address the issues and problems that face our state and our nation."
The Mississippi Republican Party is fundamentally committed to conservative principles, including individual freedom, personal responsibility, free market economic policies, and a society that respects our God-given rights of life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.
For more information about the Mississippi Republican Party, please visit [www.MSGOP.org](https://substack.com/redirect/e80a6300-b5ca-45ad-a49c-dd0c71047296?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (http://www.MSGOP.org). For information about the Tippah County GOP, please visit [www.TippahGOP.org](https://substack.com/redirect/dec319cd-6d76-4c7f-9b37-2aac88d87e8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (http://www.TippahGOP.org).
For any media inquiries or further information, please contact Dana Criswell, Chairman of the Tippah County Republican Party, at VoteRepublican@TippahGOP.org or on cell at 901-275-4191.

subject: Climate change is the greatest threat to humanity – But it isn’t too late to act:
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Blue Amp Action PAC
body:
| | | | |
---

---
