---
| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7a0fe21a-b9b0-4031-8aa4-7d4547b94cbf/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| | | | | Below is a personal message from Dr. Michael Mann – one of the world’s leading climate experts and the recipient of the Tyler Prize (often called the Nobel Prize for the Environment). [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T67d7e4c5-bbc3-48ff-8e94-9619793c4120/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I have spent my entire career researching the Earth’s climate and the climate crisis facing our planet. I have been attacked for my research, investigated by Republicans, and the target of countless smear campaigns to try and discredit my work over the years. I wanted to reach out personally to say first and foremost: In my professional opinion, climate change is the greatest threat facing humanity’s long-term survival. But! And I want to emphasize this: I am NOT a climate alarmist or pessimist. I am still an optimist. It isn’t too late for us to change course (and I make the case for that [in my new book ‘Our Fragile Moment’](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3c6e5e15-9675-4bdb-adf5-6e7122d7e228/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)). But our window to act is closing and I genuinely fear it will be too late if Republicans sweep to power in November and roll back all of the progress we’ve made these past few years. I’m humbly asking: [Will you make a donation to my friends at 314 Action and Blue Amp Action ahead of their deadline at midnight? They are working to elect climate scientists and climate champions at all levels of government and they can’t do this work without you. ](https://default.salsalabs.org/T14b7b664-8428-4ae0-8e7f-58515c32d748/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) You might not recognize my name. But chances are you’ve seen my work: I authored the original ‘Hockey Stick’ Chart as part of my 1999 publication that demonstrated the clear link between human greenhouse gas emissions and global warming that has been widely featured across the world. So believe me when I tell you that under President Joe Biden and under Democratic majorities in Congress and state legislatures, the most aggressive and important climate legislation in our nation’s history has been passed into law in the past few years and is taking effect. It’s a good start but we need to do more. In fact, for humanity’s sake, we have to do more. But if Republicans take power this November, they will slam the brakes on all of those policies, programs, and initiatives. They will block any meaningful future ones and in fact, will hand the steering wheel of our country over to the fossil fuel industry. This is the most pivotal election for climate to date. My friends at 314 Action elected the only two climate scientists in Congress (in highly competitive races) thanks to supporters like you. And they’re working to elect HUNDREDS of Democratic scientists who have pledged to take action on climate this November. If these candidates win their tough races, we will secure a climate majority in Congress and in state legislatures across the country. [Our window to act is closing. 🦅 Act Now! Secure American Freedoms This Week! | | | [ ](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=ae91387b8b&e=5c740fa3e2)

| This week's 3 most important things you need to know or actions you need to take to help us recapture our cities, state, and nation.

Thank you for subscribing & staying subscribed!
---
| | | **
ANNOUNCING!
THE GRASSROOTS FREEDOM PAC!
SUPPORT GRASSROOTS SCHOOL BOARDS!**

---
|
We have started a federal PAC - Political Action Committee - to have a vehicle through which to raise funds from grassroots Ohioans to battle the monied special interests, party insiders, and career politicians from both sides of the aisle. It's called **"The Grassroots Freedom PAC"**.

We are putting a governance & decision-making team in place to assure you that your donations will be used wisely to support activities & candidates whose platforms, experience, and character are what's needed to unite us, make us healthier (in all regards), and generate an environment that breeds prosperity.

In the meantime, those of us doing this work are 100% certain that we need more School Board members in Ohio who believe in parents' rights, getting back to the basics of education, and depoliticizing public education in Ohio.

The maiden effort of the Grassroots Freedom PAC is raising funds to support like-minded school board candidates for NEXT YEAR'S school board elections, which are in November 2025.

This gives us well over a year to donate what we can to raise funds for these important elected offices.

Please consider giving what you can on a monthly basis. $5? $10? $100?

If 10,000 Ohioans gave $20/mo. for one year, we would have $2,400,000 to help support candidates across Ohio at this time next year. To donate, click on the image below or click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=28ed089ba5&e=5c740fa3e2).

If you have any questions, please contact **Mark Pukita** at **614-499-0599 (c)** by text or call.

| [](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f8e9a5687e&e=5c740fa3e2)

NORTHEAST OHIO • MEDINA
APRIL 10TH! • FREE!
PLEASE FORWARD & SHARE!**

---
|
**This Wednesday, April 10th! **An election integrity event in northeast Ohio you will not want to miss!

It's at 7:00 PM at 7291 Stone Road in Medina, hosted by Ohio Freedom Fighters. TONS OF FREE PARKING! For more information contact **Linda Kelly** at **330-607-4165.**

Thank you!
---
|

|
---
| |
**GRASSROOTS OHIO PROVISIONS!
SUPPORT GRASSROOTS CAUSES!**

---
|
**What's this all about?**
Have you noticed how money wins most Ohio elections? Have you noticed how Ohio's grassroots, small-government, freedom-loving candidates almost always have a money disadvantage against insider, establishment, career politicians?

**Grassroots Ohio Provisions is part of the answer!**
100% of the proceeds from your purchase of these products goes to the [**Grassroots Freedom PAC**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=271548d14f&e=5c740fa3e2) to be used to fund Ohio's grassroots, small-government, freedom-loving candidates & activities in Ohio to get them elected to fix our broken locales, state, and country! Click on the image below or click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=f5fd98819a&e=5c740fa3e2) to go to the Grassroots Ohio Provisions online store.

**Who's behind this effort?**
This effort is the brainchild of many concerned Ohio grassroots, small-government, freedom-loving activists from many organizations around Ohio. To see a comprehensive list & how you can join us, please click [**HERE**](https://gfiohio.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=c2cee5a5358289d5dd20ff17d&id=769b20baf6&e=5c740fa3e2). Thank you!

_**"In God We Trust"**_

body:
Support the FIRST campaign in MI-04 to file petition signatures! | | | | |
---
Dear Friend,

name: Stephanie Mohr
subject: Emergency pardon petition
body:
Right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job.

| |
---
| |
---
Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I’m asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z7cmbmof3hen1g52ujp96lvtldcm5i03fpq1h7j8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck – and involved the department’s helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home – and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver’s side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage.When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.)No doubt Eric saved his partner’s life that afternoon – and probably his own.**But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric’s case – exhausting his options through the justice system._Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_**A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric’s last remaining options for freedom.****[Now you know why I’m asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zfg7bd1s3163gsecd95647q9cr1keh0ga5kumm28_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I’m proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund – a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom.I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George’s County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book – including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect’s civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials – in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me – I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones – not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense – but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name.That’s why I can’t turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won’t either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zi5hv7vb8sqp045n6ulkkk953lm9m8jlf3olk8n8_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can’t get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head.But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won’t you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zml0pfstoe7qh3tfbfdqjpg85biekhu6tv0gv3eg_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support.Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric’s freedom and restore his good name, I’m begging you to [**sign the Emergency Pardon Petition today**.](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zge9vmsfjqg13pqd02eajh0dvo39mrfs7scvutd0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)Thank you in advance for your support.
---
| | Gratefully,
---
---
Stephanie MohrDirector, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere – a decorated Kansas City Police Detective – will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won’t have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. **[Will you please take 30 seconds right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition and help me fight for Eric’s freedom?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zda5c048llburha3iduemqcbbbo7s1roogl3vou0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)** I hope you’ll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. No matter what, please pray for Eric and his heartbroken family.
---
[**SIGN THE PETITION**](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z4v0d8b0vvtf8nqgfi1aj607b7vb9morronsogl0_rp22sh2s8i6ep32cdge9oj4clh2bs)

The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

Growing up, I never thought about “party” or “partisanship.” It just wasn’t something my parents (both lifelong Republicans) talked about. Here’s what they did teach me: that everyone deserves a fair shot; to help the people in my community who need it; and that all people are worthy of dignity and respect. That’s why I spent nearly thirty years as a special education teacher — to make sure kids who needed an advocate in school had one. body:
When you hired me as State Treasurer in 2020, I made a promise - now I’m ready to do it again as your next U.S. Representative for West Virginia Congressional District 2.

| [](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=212eaa1246384f2b8d4c3fe8ba9dd017&_e=A8h4PhUNpyUxPIsWhIb2YrWk1oNFVaRjAXcz26pV9zwkDyQZ9HnYsW6RBdNcDaLWnnjFuet_Dg5c970xepeZdnWbH15rIcdq2y8rEseUEVFP3X2e5dEG4D_-hYCOF4e16L2n9qtGQ9JTS52z06UGOiqnEchtbj-Llo8vTk1tI_aO3Ncpi_Ft0E2rZCo4WTIpfafAb30EW4s__b47Rf1gy9rjX3rpYxPuVOD8e0KhJKng5rOhippWM43lFYnzqtwgo-yFkhPzjcaA1vD1KkT4i2Kcn5YE1hdXVNW8NvEInmesWBUiNfqQbh7IN7WVOuqQRhmqRu26A9MDxIlySKhyN0RDxFftcCRdEA_6nBhSq3Tf5TggwSqazGmR8bHRZ1Z9W1UAaNeeiEM24ufC7sYs8w%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American,

I made a promise when you hired me as State Treasurer four years ago. As the next U.S. Representative for West Virginia’s 2nd Congressional District (God willing), I’m ready to do it again.

I promised you that I would get to work for all West Virginians and deliver on our shared goals; goals that will take our state from good to great, and make it the best place for people to live, work, and raise their families.

As I run for a new office, I promise to continue pushing West Virginia to be the best it can be. I’m prepared to fight for you by working to:

* Decrease inflation and put hard-earned dollars back into the pockets of Americans

* Invest in our teachers and children so the next generation can reach their full potential (no more CRT curriculum in schools)

* Put our economy back on track & get folks back to work

* Secure our border to STOP the drugs, crime, and human trafficking poisoning our communities

* Support law enforcement and our military, who work to keep us safe at home and overseas

| [**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=212eaa1246384f2b8d4c3fe8ba9dd017&_e=A8h4PhUNpyUxPIsWhIb2YrWk1oNFVaRjAXcz26pV9zwkDyQZ9HnYsW6RBdNcDaLWnnjFuet_Dg5c970xepeZdnWbH15rIcdq2y8rEseUEVFP3X2e5dEG4D_-hYCOF4e16L2n9qtGQ9JTS52z06UGOiqnEchtbj-Llo8vTk1tI_aO3Ncpi_Ft0E2rZCo4WTIpIHizfQNhs_dx1Nd8irhSxiJFE9JpdMYLlkDTJJoCi5_r4tPW7z4zjUqWWRsVzHDElAVD4JFtS7CFDMK7DiJNEC3bOHIV1kkAghdBws_LG5L9O22A2ctaqASVY3-T0a1x2Q3ygpRNgoQJJy4g9Ym8K8v3LVssmgiW6ehWADq7eB63EIeDfUiy_v7YrYwz3ojH1x7YjCSbbkmFotdGkxnUew%3D%3D)
---

We can do all of this together, not because of partisan views, but because we know these common sense solutions will deliver the best results for all of West Virginia and America.

All of these shared goals are at risk from the far Left Democrats who are trying to take control of the House, Senate, and White House in 2024. They are trying to lead West Virginia and America down a path toward higher taxes, higher crime, higher inflation, unsafe communities, and fewer jobs.

As your next Congressman, I refuse to let that happen. I’m not going to stand by and let them steal your paychecks and raise your taxes to fund their bogus plans. I’m not going to let our border remain wide open and crime flood into our communities. I’m not going to let them take jobs out of West Virginia.

I promise to find common-sense solutions to defend West Virginia and prevent the Left from tearing apart the American Dream even further. I appreciate your support as I aim to deliver on these promises.

[**STAND WITH RILEY MOORE**](https://click.historyoftheday.com/u/click?_t=930f96a60371422687dbefcfca24c32b&_m=212eaa1246384f2b8d4c3fe8ba9dd017&_e=A8h4PhUNpyUxPIsWhIb2YrWk1oNFVaRjAXcz26pV9zwkDyQZ9HnYsW6RBdNcDaLWnnjFuet_Dg5c970xepeZdnWbH15rIcdq2y8rEseUEVFP3X2e5dEG4D_-hYCOF4e16L2n9qtGQ9JTS52z06UGOiqnEchtbj-Llo8vTk1tI_aO3Ncpi_Ft0E2rZCo4WTIpIHizfQNhs_dx1Nd8irhSxiJFE9JpdMYLlkDTJJoCi599zgaLjuP3nw02YtCBDt_gGWXkNPsJZWWxmdAKTeDn5lcx66ts7xlzjjz4yohmCf8ZJPyGNrWqGcOmkgTQwV4HSAN2ct2-UlT7qovV2Q262f8j9Yzf2UZTw5VyLSla85RCPfjKEvZGPOm4K6A2tF4OvC2baj2IyxQgYP_lkxQv_Q%3D%3D)
---

Thank you for your support,

Riley Moore

|
**RILEY MOORE: CONSERVATIVE FOR CONGRESS.**

* * *
Washington is all tied up in putting politics over principle.
It’s time to put a stop to it and start putting PRINCIPLES OVER POLITICS - starting with YOU!

Hey there — greetings from Washington! I’m back in D.C. working to get the Farm Bill over the finish line so that farmers across our district have the resources they need to keep feeding our communities. name: Mariela Roca
subject: Re: Removing Conservative Candidates from Platform
body:
| | | | | |
---
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=5f42937cab&e=0a12281e0e)
This week we received the following notification from CallHub, a Digital Organizing, Campaigning & Canvassing Platform for Political campaigns that we have been using since 2021:
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
This company has decided to remove us from their platform because our campaign is for a Republican candidate and we don’t “align with their values”.
Our campaign had been using Call Hub since 2021 during our last race as we were looking for options to be able to send text messages at a lower cost and in ways we could internally send messages and make phone calls without having to outsource this process to a company where we would have to pay more for the service.
Fast forward to May 2023 when CallHub decided to make their “values” public. In which they state they only work with Democrat candidates.
We didn’t realize this since we have been using this service for a few years and have not had any prior issues with this. CallHub was more than happy to approve our political campaign knowing we were Republican in August 2023.
They approved the account as a Republican candidate after their so-called “values” were published. So what has changed now?
My thought is that they are monitoring us and now know that we have a real chance at winning this seat and pose a threat to the “liberal” and “progressive” candidates they support.
While we are happy that we now know who we were inadvertently doing business with, it now leaves our campaign in a predicament where now 30 days before the election we need to scramble to find another service and get re-certified as a political entity to be able to send these messages and reach voters. This all costs money and takes time away from everything we had planned for the next 30 days.
It’s sad that conservative candidates continue to be silenced and censored by companies like this. But we are going to push forward and adapt and overcome like we always do.
Please consider helping the campaign out today by donating to our text message fund below so we can get our texting service back and running today without any delay. Donate by clicking below. ⬇️
[DONATE TO THE TEXT MESSAGE FUND](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=536f29229e&e=0a12281e0e)
# Postcards and Mailers on the way to voter mailboxes! 💌
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
Very excited to announce that our very first batch of postcards and mailers have been sent and are on the way to voters across the 6th district!
Our Amazing Team Roca volunteers have been handwriting postcards for the last couple of months and it truly has been a labor of love. We have already been receiving feedback from voters who have already started receiving postcards and they are truly making an impact.
We have also sent out our first batch of 10,000 mailers to Republican absentee voters in the district. Absentee ballots have already been mailed by the state of Maryland, and it was crucial that our campaign get these out on time.
We still have work to do with sending postcards and mailers. Our goal is to send at least 3K more postcards and 20K mailers to voters. This is one of the parts of the campaign that cost a lot of money to complete.
If you would like to help us with our last batch of postcards and mailers, please consider donating to our postcard and mailer fund by clicking below. ⬇️
[DONATE TO POSTCARD & MAILER FUND](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9addc94575&e=0a12281e0e)
# Upcoming Meet & Greets 🤝🏼
| | | | | | | | |
---
|
---
Our remaining Meet & Greet events for the primary election have been scheduled! We will be meeting at Ledo Pizza in Frederick on April 16th and Bistro 11 & Lounge on April 23rd. These are the last planned events to come meet Mariela and hear what great things the campaign is working on, and how we plan to WIN in 2024. If you are in the area and interested in attending, please visit our events page by clicking below. ⬇️
[EVENTS PAGE](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=28ceeaafef&e=0a12281e0e)
# Fundraising 🙏🏽
With absentee ballots set to be mailed out by the state of Maryland starting on or after March 30th, we are facing a tight deadline to ensure our message reaches every voter in our district. To make this happen, we must raise a minimum of $20,000 by April 20th in order to get our materials out in time.
Your contribution today will play a crucial role in funding our outreach efforts, including mailers, text messages, phone calls, and postcards. Here is what our campaign needs help with in the next 30 days to get over the finish line:
1. **Postcard Mailing:** $3,000
2. **Mailer:** $8,000
3. **Door Hangers:** $1,000
4. **Texting:** $2,000
5. **Digital Advertising:** $6,000

We understand that these are challenging times, but the future of our district and country is at stake. We need your help now more than ever. Please consider donating today to help us get through the primary election on May 14th here in Maryland.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution:
[**rocaforcongress.com/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=3fa4da6f28&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=31df85171d&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b924084c0a&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|
---
# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=e225f84566&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=caf28374a1&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=4aa1df8d3c&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=214ff1e5dc&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a5ffcb7893&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b2950b6085&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=bb2f5025d3&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=05e409376b&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=ed902ee050&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=729a007b8b&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=83b5780847&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6398f015b5&e=0a12281e0e)
|

During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much. I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life. Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day. As a military veteran , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation. As a medical logistician , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything. As a mother , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families. I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before. As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future. But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country. Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again. Sincerely, Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District | | | | | | | ---|---|--- | | | Copyright (C) 2024 Roca for Congress. All rights reserved.

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: a dark day
body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
| | | | |
---
| | |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[ unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8bffb2f5-21e5-48cd-9479-540d03b4f454/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _._
---
|
---
| | | | | Peter, I am incredibly disappointed. Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born. They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War. No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest. As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass. It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance. It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over. If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster. I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign. [**Split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today and we will direct every dollar you send to us towards defeating Kari Lake and Donald Trump in Arizona. Any amount helps.** ](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb7be3b97-71fd-4c68-a4c0-b3f14335bf41/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

Ruben

We recently discovered that our opponent in the Democratic Primary, former news anchor Janelle Stelson, said something pretty shocking while reading the news for viewers in Central PA.
Stelson said, on the air, that people of Asian descent eat cat tacos
Yes, you read that right, CAT TACOS.
Stelson then goes on to laugh at her own “joke.” No one here at Team Daniels is laughing, and we’ll bet you aren’t either.
In case you think we’re exaggerating, or taking our opponent’s comments out of context, you can listen for yourself HERE [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0p6cpoguJO4]

Janelle Stelson: Of course because they’re making tacos out of them hahaha
This sounds like the kind of racist and insensitive thing that Scott Perry, or even Donald Trump, might say. Don’t we deserve someone better than that as our Democratic nominee? Don’t we deserve a REAL Democrat, someone who will represent everyone equally and fairly?

Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=11f9392231c24d06a676889b4f124116&_e=DbIYd-CTGEm8Jq1djCqJ-_caHZyVZ03f5ZgcGI_gBNC8hAs7tu6l5nXuGKlQqSi8d_p4togZAYqtmbbYdCiF2Ml6aFZJgYM58ICItRiCALzwi2Ht_cJjm1O3eeXfq1l7Sfnmwbva1y_kfGpRhHgI99MJn5qa4Y-JdiuHIBKVfpUn5imoE0owI0_--gGPFjarx-sTvdJ44aPLYEMvlTF0sMn6LHswn-zp1ZmYN8V8_wcxP1mUtgzbBr_TWPFqBEyeACyBX8SuDUy9vFC-yXmj0nNfyuALZXrHl4WJZ9jZ151sxwXWO1rzZR27DhTcR8vHMPEPzILIaIq9zpiJzxAuK6hBb-CmnQVk1K43F-0fWmePI0rY2tokgnsm3B6FyrrqdcEb2ETqExWNTYHuqu_P5258hagOEZXZWjpNNGKJyxc%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=11f9392231c24d06a676889b4f124116&_e=DbIYd-CTGEm8Jq1djCqJ-_caHZyVZ03f5ZgcGI_gBNC8hAs7tu6l5nXuGKlQqSi8d_p4togZAYqtmbbYdCiF2Ml6aFZJgYM58ICItRiCALzwi2Ht_cJjm1O3eeXfq1l7Sfnmwbva1y_kfGpRhHgI99MJn5qa4Y-JdiuHIBKVfpUn5imoE0owI0_--gGPFjarx-sTvdJ44aPLYEMvlTF0sMn6LHswn-zp1ZmYN8V8_wcxP1mUtgzbBr_TWPFqBEyeLQuaaSzKUWhmiqDYMsvTsI4WCx2mVENASyLT7t_bCD0ggco5O0dHn0NXqA38EmA4WWA7TjE8DT3wtYbVWaNvg8XLOEkFcqtgw_o2vVso8-mg79bWK-p7KfTwr_Tofjhts3fMezauAESPp7SyRNvz9-FGbWqhHpZPgyFddetBEBc%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

clean_body: 💰 = 🌲🌲 Peter – I have an exciting update on the ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway project and wanted you to be one of the first to know: Thanks to a generous matching gift from Christine Knuth, , and your gift can bring us 2X closer to our project goal of $2 million! This is the perfect chance to be part of something historic as we work in partnership with the Yurok Tribe to develop a world-class, Indigenous-owned recreational gateway to Redwood National Park. The exciting vision includes new accessible trails, increased recreation opportunities, and engaging exhibits welcoming visitors to explore the restored site, Yurok culture and ancestral lands. Please don’t wait! Be part of this historic project and your gift will go 2X as far! This vision is a shared commitment with the Yurok Tribe to rewrite the story of ‘O Rew and invite people from near and far to experience spectacular redwoods through the lens of Indigenous culture – something I know you can appreciate as a forest lover and supporter. You know the special majesty of these forests, where history and nature envelope you, and every breath feels like a gift. You will be part of something truly extraordinary. Thank you! In deep appreciation, | Tim Whalen Chief Development Officer ---|--- P.S. Your support is the foundation of everything we do, and why we can plan ambitious and exciting projects like the ‘O Rew Redwoods Gateway. * | | | | ---|---|---|--- Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States tel:415-362-2352 | |

| When Dr. Randy Naidoo, well-known DFW pediatrician and owner of Shine Pediatrics, reached out to TFVC asking to partner with us for a 2-part series on their online platform, we leapt at the opportunity! Last week we finished Part 1 - and WOW! TFVC President Rebecca Hardy and Outreach Director Carrie Bigford, in conjunction with Dr. Naidoo and nurse Christine, shared vital information on well checks for your child, CPS investigations, medical kidnapping, and divorce proceedings for parents who utilize exemptions. It was an incredible night FULL of crucial information and support for parents. **Dr. Naidoo and his team are truly setting the bar for what patient-centered care should look like.** Week Two of this forum will be THIS Thursday, April 11, and we will be covering even more useful information with Rebecca and our Political Director, Michelle Evans. Dr. Naidoo has graciously opened this up to people outside of his practice. **You can learn more about participating[HERE](https://click.mlsend.com/link/c/YT0yNDU0NTMxMTU4OTM1ODcwNDEwJmM9eThvOCZlPTAmYj0xMzA1OTY3ODA2JmQ9ZjhtMmM5cA==.6WMQ4vNbcqHutLnQRYavldRlqIDQLqA7ytAFCeySWOs).**

Peter,
A new AP report is warning about an alarming trend in the spread of right-wing election lies and conspiracy theories on social media.
As most right-wing conspiracies do these days, it all started last week when an anonymous Twitter/ “X” user posted a false claim that new voters were registering without voter ID at “skyrocketing” rates.
The tweet quickly caught fire in the right-wing ecosystem, with Elon Musk, Marjorie Taylor Green, and Donald Trump acknowledging the tweet and spreading it to their followers. **By the time state election officials stepped in to correct the misinformation, the tweet had more than 63 million views.**
[**That’s an astonishing number, and we urgently need your help to correct the record. Please support our mission to fight misinformation like this at the source by chipping in $10 today. **](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82678735/466032928/-593472309?refcode=20240409-EM-VoterMisinfo&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDc4NzgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiMWE2MzcxNjAtOTBmNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=DJVVvELpBzhZAaPQXWz08_bGCxaUM-vww9UcOgK4rfo=)
So why is Twitter/ “X” playing such an essential role in spreading right-wing misinformation?
When Elon Musk took over in 2023, he eliminated programs designed to stop the spread of misinformation in the name of free speech. That and new protections in the platform’s privacy policy made it easier for anonymous users to spread misinformation without accountability.
Further, he allowed those accounts to monetize divisive tweets. **The account that spread the voter registration misinformation last week reported making over $10,000 last year from their tweets alone.**
To top it off, Musk regularly shares the false content spread by anonymous users, effectively spreading misinformation to every corner of Twitter/ “X.”
Twitter’s downfall and the surge of right-wing misinformation online make COURIER’s mission to provide free, factual news in the spaces and places that need it most so important right now.
When we correct bad information by spreading good, we can fight the lies and conspiracies that hurt our democracy and divide our communities.
[**But that type of work takes resources, Peter. Our ten newsrooms operate around the clock to tackle misinformation on social media news feeds and in email inboxes. I ask because I have this one that was inspired by one of my heroes, the late Congressman John Lewis. Before I show you, I want to make a promise – when I'm elected to serve Maryland's 3rd district, I will support the John Lewis Voting Rights Act from Day 1. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = So, back to my tattoo. 😂 = The Black heart, that represents the struggle of Black people. It's a struggle every Black American faces throughout their life. And being a Black man, running for Congress, that's the ultimate sign I've persevered through the struggles. The blood tears are for all the bloodshed Black Americans cast, especially from historic events like Bloody Sunday. Hundreds of Black heroes, like John Lewis, took beatings that day – and some even laid down their lives so that people like me could have a voice in our democracy. And the red lightning symbolizes the chaos that ensues when you get into good trouble. Because like John Lewis said, "get in good trouble, necessary trouble, and help redeem the soul of America." It's because of my heroes that I have the opportunity to run for Congress and be one of the loudest voices fighting for our democracy. I'm following down the path they carved for Black Americans. = = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Thank you! Friends,
The GOP knows their plan to ban abortion federally isn’t popular, so they’re passing the buck to the states to stomp on women’s rights, for now .
Trump supporting “state's rights” regarding abortion is just an attempt to neutralize Democrats for a presidential election.
Most Americans believe the SCOTUS decision overturning Roe v Wade is unjust, and Trump Republicans know candidates like me will fight like hell to rectify it.
Sorry, I don’t trust Trump, his actions, or his intentions. He's proud he overturned Roe. This is for political gain, for power, nothing more.
My opponent, Rep. Jack Bergman was a co-sponsor of two bills banning abortions nationally, one that would imprison medical providers. He votes against contraception and supports restricting IVF.
That type of draconian perspective doesn't change. It just becomes dormant for an election.
Reproductive healthcare is healthcare. Healthcare should be considered a human right in every state in the nation and with your help [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext] , I'll work hard in Congress to ensure geography isn't a factor in every American's quality of care.
-Dr. Bob

| | **For Immediate Release:** April 9, 2024
**Contact:** [press@davemin.com](mailto:press@davemin.com)
**Reproductive Freedom for All Endorses Dave Min for Congress**
**IRVINE, CA** — Reproductive Freedom for All (formerly NARAL) announced its endorsement of California State Senator Dave Min for Congress, recognizing his substantial contributions to advancing reproductive freedom and healthcare rights in California.

**“With Trump and the Republican Party working to ban abortion in all 50 states, California is ground zero for taking back the House so that we can lock in the reproductive freedom majority who will restore the federal right to abortion,”** said Reproductive Freedom for All President and CEO Mini Timmaraju.**“Dave Min will fight relentlessly for reproductive freedom, and we need to send them to Washington to do exactly that. We are proud to endorse them and will be working side by side with our members in California to make sure they’re elected this November.”**

A staunch supporter of reproductive rights, Senator Min has played a key role in legislative efforts to safeguard and extend reproductive freedoms in the Golden State. His authorship of Proposition 1, which successfully enshrined abortion rights into the California Constitution, marks a significant achievement in the protection of these rights against an ever-changing and challenging political climate. Moreover, through initiatives like SB 374, Senator Min has broadened the dialogue surrounding reproductive rights and domestic violence, making California the pioneering state to classify reproductive coercion as a form of domestic violence. This legislative milestone recognizes the intricate relationship between reproductive rights and gender-based violence, establishing a model for the entire country to follow.

**"The right to reproductive freedom and the autonomy to make healthcare decisions is non-negotiable,”** said Senator Min. **“My work in Sacramento has been centered around reinforcing abortion rights as core constitutional protections, and I am determined to extend this advocacy to Congress. I aim to champion the federal codification of Roe v. Wade and confront the challenges posed by the current judicial landscape. The restrictions we are seeing in Red states on reproductive healthcare are putting people’s lives in danger. Everyone has the right to be in control of their body, their healthcare and their future.”**

A former University of California Irvine Law Professor, Min has spent his career in public service fighting for the American Dream. After graduating from Harvard Law School right after the Enron and Worldcom accounting scandals, Min turned down high-paying corporate law jobs to instead prosecute corporate fraud at the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). He went on to serve as an economic policy director on Capitol Hill, fighting for economic fairness and opportunity during the height of the mortgage crisis, before coming back home to California to teach at what was then a brand new law school at UC Irvine.

Min, who currently represents over 80% of CA-47 in the State Senate, has a proven track record of winning in Orange County, having defeated a longstanding Republican incumbent in 2020 and becoming the first Democrat to represent the region in the State Senate. Senator Min has been a champion on women’s reproductive rights, gun safety, and climate justice in the California Legislature, and he has also been a stalwart leader on public safety and education issues, earning the endorsements of Orange County’s Police Officers, Deputy Sheriffs, Firefighters, and Teachers.

Dave Min is endorsed by outgoing Rep. Katie Porter, as well as the California Democratic Party, Service Employees International Union (SEIU), the National Education Association, the American Federation of Teachers, California Environmental Voters, and over 150 local, state, and federal officials. Min is the unanimous choice of organized labor in this race, as he is the only candidate to receive support from national, statewide, and local unions, and he is the only candidate endorsed in this race by the California Labor Federation or the AFL-CIO. A full endorsement list is available [here](https://davemin.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1b97cb6a343b55cba640c3404&id=c237a6207f&e=7017cc100e). ###

_California’s 47th is an open Congressional District in Orange County that includes the Cities of Costa Mesa, Huntington Beach, Irvine, Newport Beach, and Seal Beach, and portions of Laguna Beach, Laguna Hills, and Laguna Woods. Incumbent Katie Porter is vacating the seat to run for U.S. Senate. In 2022, Porter defeated former Assemblymember Republican Scott Baugh by 3.44% in this “toss-up” district. State Senator Dave Min currently represents over 80% of Congressional District 47 in Sacramento. In 2020, Min received over 158,000 votes within CA-47, defeating incumbent John Moorlach by 5.15% in this area. 19% of the registered voters in CA-47 are of Asian and Pacific Islander descent, including one of the largest Korean-American populations in the country. _

We want to share some numbers with you about the Texas electorate:
During the 2022 elections, Texas had 7.9 million registered, likely Republicans and only 7.5 million registered, likely Democrats — **a deficit of nearly half a million registered voters.**
Here’s the hard truth about those figures:
While we may be able to overcome this voter registration deficit in close local and state house races, it will remain difficult to win statewide elections — for governor, U.S. Senate, President, and more — until we register more Democrats to vote.

body:

# [](https://act.hillharper.com/go/421?t=1&akid=1147%2E62735%2Eyzr0Dm)
Hi there -- I’m **Marilyn Harper, Hill’s mother!**
[](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1229?t=2&akid=1147%2E62735%2Eyzr0Dm)
Peter, I was _immensely_ proud of Hill when he told me he was running to represent Michigan in the U.S. Senate.**
Ever since he was a boy, he’s had a passion for service to others -- and I've watched him carry those values with him throughout his life. Harry and I raised him to be compassionate, loving, and empathetic. **We raised him to make life better for the people around him, and I know deep in my heart it’s the reason he jumped into this Senate race.**
Hill has what it takes because he’s always been a fighter — whether in law school, during his battle with cancer, or as a single father looking after his mother and young son under one roof.
But Hill is facing some tough odds, and while I’m his biggest cheerleader, it’s going to take a lot more than a mother’s love and support to get him across the finish line. **[If you could chip in just $5, $10, or even $25, I know it will go a long way in helping him build the campaign he needs to win.](https://act.hillharper.com/go/1230?t=3&akid=1147%2E62735%2Eyzr0Dm)**

name: Tim Sheehy, Navy SEAL
subject: I’d never had thoughts like this before
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA
body:
When I saw everything that we’d worked for in Afghanistan washed away in a matter of days, I decided to consider serving in government once again | [](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=49f5df1c204e43b9a9518f4a5f2b1a6f&_e=IU_79re92b6eXs8QTMR3JuhhapHu3p0h_YmcWuH8hEayqFd0E3ndqwr8cPvp02LSLgdl60sdHv9QEo2SnKCy-ElDrlMBRfVKwA2O-8n8UlXyOVisRxbSGDvxZbpkkRV6g0gKXc60S19Gh_WGbWg-vjPe1wKCagtCbluDikwPX9RugQxURgUyM4hGFZEdw1lCSsoRlrGbXo2j6bWkUtml57BDVI2USXHVcxUKZ7d8igq55SohnL2w0KYPVg8KocgEB1hcxj9eLJaRH3wVMHFBS1AZrZUWxOMlr9C5A8WhqIEAlJBkNnnAUUKBk0bG8yogl96BPc1ZF-TrqeccYqUMbQTjN-XppB_3HlZXl001ePHHovM_6xvw-hhmPobUAlm7MAptSa9xxzuKScvVqW7XkstroxPLfhnXsgy3oEkoXWU%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=49f5df1c204e43b9a9518f4a5f2b1a6f&_e=IU_79re92b6eXs8QTMR3JuhhapHu3p0h_YmcWuH8hEayqFd0E3ndqwr8cPvp02LSLgdl60sdHv9QEo2SnKCy-ElDrlMBRfVKwA2O-8n8UlXyOVisRxbSGDvxZbpkkRV6g0gKXc60S19Gh_WGbWg-vjPe1wKCagtCbluDikwPX9RugQxURgUyM4hGFZEdw1lCSsoRlrGbXo2j6bWkUtml57BDVI2USXHVcxUKZ7d8igq55SohnL2w0KYPVg8KocgEXD4oHOFvQKsHhSHwvW3Kwib87XA57Ns8LGLZmdqDYm3SxFDMjdDtFVFTOoNPyND0h9xHrZwxl_gdzXk1BzhGI47BPu5hGc_zolxfZBxE6KvblRy3H2pL4BGw3DSlxVlmNHadRH8qyF8akGaT91PSSH-SeK9Af_p6aYZwgDWVBVo%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=49f5df1c204e43b9a9518f4a5f2b1a6f&_e=IU_79re92b6eXs8QTMR3JuhhapHu3p0h_YmcWuH8hEayqFd0E3ndqwr8cPvp02LSLgdl60sdHv9QEo2SnKCy-ElDrlMBRfVKwA2O-8n8UlXyOVisRxbSGDvxZbpkkRV6g0gKXc60S19Gh_WGbWg-vjPe1wKCagtCbluDikwPX9RugQxURgUyM4hGFZEdw1lCSsoRlrGbXo2j6bWkUtml57BDVI2USXHVcxUKZ7d8igq55SohnL2w0KYPVg8KocgE2GKvEI4X6x6HdaGH-H6rHlXu38ulQ4Zd2YFx9Yn4b8NMHNpC2I9f5of9BCFtyF9Cm0p9pOzRh5vtcfgnrFKAfeP8DGqKy1duU5qw94x8OaJRXA-a_LjiiGRp8enmDWExk8wuwFaRKCVmmbNOGJpH2yD-B7PAnj-PM3Lip1fIwGU%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=49f5df1c204e43b9a9518f4a5f2b1a6f&_e=IU_79re92b6eXs8QTMR3JuhhapHu3p0h_YmcWuH8hEayqFd0E3ndqwr8cPvp02LSgymM7cOMuZbjYQr6jQ4XbVCj4XUstRBV6nY0JPs34M7oI4wgZojRsCc7VvHFeOjYrHbKLghPPy-qvvsBTo6ezpsjzXtljGZOa6-56Cr8NUVvQhNl9He0sjFNR5okDjnVi30hj8xIHmRl5hlJOuG-5JdSATuYfwH9jujLb8_2LEliX4obzbu3JBdG2L4jC1MAiwXVgZnuGAb1Hj1w7kiL1Cq1Gb3v77PUTG1H2z4zx2tkrhE5yDQleavEt7U2md-rMN2NwZ4kJF8JPMvLomhykEP8DQO63_CFo_U2QN1x7mfO9oL5xZRcTlfoxDnxVW4jWvl4ES0Li6Tc1bjlRIZpVfFzMvCE10ldJiqr2QTy5iQ%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=49f5df1c204e43b9a9518f4a5f2b1a6f&_e=IU_79re92b6eXs8QTMR3JuhhapHu3p0h_YmcWuH8hEayqFd0E3ndqwr8cPvp02LSLgdl60sdHv9QEo2SnKCy-ElDrlMBRfVKwA2O-8n8UlXyOVisRxbSGDvxZbpkkRV6g0gKXc60S19Gh_WGbWg-vjPe1wKCagtCbluDikwPX9RugQxURgUyM4hGFZEdw1lCSsoRlrGbXo2j6bWkUtml57BDVI2USXHVcxUKZ7d8igq55SohnL2w0KYPVg8KocgEyXMp1Wpbl8UOWnS81xl-M6qgKw3ygX-dIVTaDT1iJxfurr2vOO38e60L7YBwUa-8GEINyNLe49tCJkm3nt4tdIiEd4viWvje-i2IHK12SgCMLS3RacCBiyVxPDrdC6bUEOdCauZ3fdwlx9_0wPpph0MpVbpP7FnUuzJguK12x5I%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

subject: Fire and brimstone

body:
You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists.

| |

---
| | | My fellow Americans - this is Speaker Mike Johnson.

_You've never seen fire and brimstone until you've gone head-to-head with Trump-hating socialists. _

So you can imagine the immediate wrath I faced when I went on record supporting Donald J. Trump for President. I was just talking to my friend, Steve Scalise - he faced the same thing when he endorsed Trump too.

_**[He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we've got to stick together.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c348e77c64794fd195ba296a8d62e2f1&_e=jZnkAvqpafVp5za8DGJR8eVZDhJPegk62D3KatOu8n9WxgRuWw_FOwILcdzkHDacQ8tqDW_d5OiVqvOwEZ7o-u-_Eb6L9M4UpxSjwnGjxHNzQbh17zzn2q_sMv5trtOdXTVj-H7Ueca9h0BnIImgWo7_KupeZkLjqCU3e13VUztzTV9iYyEPBlErv3kJmnex6Lku2Nxa9TypMhj1yXObokNmnfiPbYwKt9ZaFCizIFm3whlMhBH-FOyVSXX27G-eoIA9BtV1sp60ch5nkZmamLnqpEfkHR-ypHnDoIBZe1TAqEVSjO_EUwe5Fx4WPh2VAZIN7A6y8bYNT_keTz3ORM3JtSJvxm98q_E7Z62QKpJHwQBp3Oh7bII9CmEsWwo7FdLuDUmTaPqaWkyFZ65G5iqnmh5r9zKGt0-NrECl_sk%3D "He and I agree: as strong Pro-Trump Conservatives, we’ve got to stick together.")**_

That's because the anti-Trump Media... Young radicals on college campuses... the holier-than-thou elites in Hollywood... Democrat Super PACs... Joe Biden's army of megadonors... They are fully committed to destroying our movement and replacing EVERY LAST ONE OF US with a Liberal Democrat.

But wait, that's not even the half of it. It gets worse:
** Problem #1: ** We have TWO imminent Special Elections and Democrats committed more than five million dollars to install more Liberals.

** Problem #2: ** House Democrats have forty million bucks stashed away to attack pro-Trump Conservatives like us.

** Problem #3: ** Joe Biden just bragged about raising a million bucks in a SINGLE DAY attacking President Trump.
I cannot stress the urgency of the situation enough. Early voting is about to start in the first Special Election AND the Left's fundraising advantage grows by the minute...

_**[So as one of my first moves of the election year, I'm teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c348e77c64794fd195ba296a8d62e2f1&_e=jZnkAvqpafVp5za8DGJR8eVZDhJPegk62D3KatOu8n9WxgRuWw_FOwILcdzkHDacQ8tqDW_d5OiVqvOwEZ7o-u-_Eb6L9M4UpxSjwnGjxHNzQbh17zzn2q_sMv5trtOdXTVj-H7Ueca9h0BnIImgWo7_KupeZkLjqCU3e13VUztzTV9iYyEPBlErv3kJmnex6Lku2Nxa9TypMhj1yXObokNmnfiPbYwKt9ZaFCizIFm3whlMhBH-FOyVSXX27G-eIc2cmyzD5RrQUldUwZ0vwoTrMFol7NpqkV6_dnG5oU_yvRld6NIdAsFFYu_BvLN8DgpHYLcbtbn2jGMKeiIi4jATWZlFDbBTvAZVhYM5KbyJUzry5anvo3NBP8z4wmOMXkWuiMGHOFxNEqja8TFA1D1ld3HwnzjIH5K40XHNmVM%3D "So as one of my first moves of the election year, I’m teaming up with my fellow Louisianian, Steve Scalise, to set a goal of raising one million dollars between now and the end of the month.")**_

I know, I know - that's a big goal. I get that. But that's as low as I could possibly make it to fully fund our campaign operations in every must-win swing state.

If we fail to hit it, the consequences would be unthinkable. We'd have no choice but to: **1) ** SCRAP our get-out-the-vote operations, **2) ** SLASH the budget for our ad campaigns, and **3) ** Throw our digital outreach plans IN THE TRASH CAN.

Nothing - and I mean NOTHING - would be worse for our plans to defend our razor-thin House Majority. **That 's why I'm calling for reinforcements. **

_I know the economy is in bad shape under Joe Biden. So if that 's preventing you from pitching in $100 or $50 - I completely understand. But if you can afford JUST $10 or even $5, I would be grateful beyond measure. _

_**[I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.](http://links.standingstrongamerica.com/u/click?_t=29c3b6e742c849fabbcc130432510e66&_m=c348e77c64794fd195ba296a8d62e2f1&_e=jZnkAvqpafVp5za8DGJR8eVZDhJPegk62D3KatOu8n9WxgRuWw_FOwILcdzkHDacQ8tqDW_d5OiVqvOwEZ7o-u-_Eb6L9M4UpxSjwnGjxHNzQbh17zzn2q_sMv5trtOdXTVj-H7Ueca9h0BnIImgWo7_KupeZkLjqCU3e13VUztzTV9iYyEPBlErv3kJmnex6Lku2Nxa9TypMhj1yXObokNmnfiPbYwKt9ZaFCizIFm3whlMhBH-FOyVSXX27G-ea5QNSToeZmXH6d8Bve8TGD0UAUtqpZfot0F6y9iTIZ8UFDSFEcDf8G5It0-WB1lni6_6cL_310MeTXwMVcyaootAnnQPZe1AS5ymrfI3m1N8GEwstotvmkRwI7QqLrVpcPcH4m4ksF_E3Lcdro24vl7-hW6QsMioO40__6SVDDE%3D "I only ask everyone reading this to pitch for a few bucks or whatever you can afford.")**_

When the stakes are this high, that's what will be the difference between saving our Republican Majority and losing to the Trump-hating Democrats. So can I count on you to pitch in SOMETHING?

name: Ruben Gallego
subject: Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Serve America PAC
body:
Team , I am incredibly disappointed.
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is NOT over.
If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.
I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.
Split a donation between my campaign and Serve America today and we will direct every dollar you send to us towards defeating Kari Lake and Donald Trump in Arizona. Any amount helps. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-gallego]

The reactions to the collapse of the Francis Scott Key Bridge in Baltimore present a stark difference in approaches to disaster.

**The Biden Approach:** Clear the channels and rebuild the bridge ASAP to get tens of thousands of people back to work on the docks, in the trucks and in the ships all up and down the East Coast. Not to mention cutting commuters’ cost in time and money. Collect from the insurance companies as fast as we can.

**The Perry Approach:** The United States government should do nothing. Quoth Perry: “...the shipping company that ran into the bridge also has complete liability for the accident. They’re insured to pay for that and that’s where we should be looking. It shouldn’t be the taxpayer.”

If history is any indication:
1. It will take years to collect from the insurance company as it goes to court to escape liability by blaming the shipping company, the harbormaster, the tug boat operators and maybe even the government for not passing more stringent safety regulations. Meanwhile, working people and their families suffer.

2. The insurance company could declare bankruptcy, leaving taxpayers on the hook anyway. Meanwhile, working people and their families suffer.

**If the South Bridge suddenly collapsed, which approach would you want for our people and communities in York, Dauphin and Cumberland counties?**

Me, too.

If the South Bridge suddenly collapsed, which approach would you want for our people and communities in York, Dauphin and Cumberland counties? Peter,
Just hours ago, the Arizona Supreme Court upheld a pre-statehood law that bans abortions in almost all cases.
This law effectively means an end to abortions in Arizona.
Horrified doesn’t begin to cover how I feel.
This law was passed in 1864. Before Arizona was a state and before women could vote or own property.
Now, it will insert politicians into the most intimate decisions a person will make about their bodies. It will take away rights and freedoms earned by generations of Arizona women. And it will mandate prison time for anyone who helps a woman get an abortion, which could include friends and family as well as medical professionals.
When Donald Trump and Juan Ciscomani say abortion should be left up to the states with a wink and a nod — this is what they mean.
This must be reversed by the people. In Congress, I will fight to restore Roe v. Wade into law, and that starts by defeating Juan Ciscomani, who has voted again and again to restrict abortion access.

subject: a dark day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
| Team, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

_**Biden Sabotages Medicare Advantage**_ By Bobby Jindal and Charlie Katebi
---
President Biden accuses Republicans of seeking to cut Medicare. In his 2025 budget proposal to Congress, Mr. Biden vowed to “reject any efforts to cut or undermine the Medicare or Social Security benefits that seniors and people with disabilities have earned and paid into their entire working lives.” That’s a noble promise, but Mr. Biden’s own administration is undermining Medicare’s most popular and effective program: Medicare Advantage.

This year, the number of Medicare Advantage plans available to seniors decreased nationwide. In Alabama, Louisiana and New Mexico, the number of plans available decreased more than 20%. At the same time, Medicare Advantage plans have become significantly more expensive on Mr. Biden’s watch. In 2023 the average Medicare Advantage beneficiary experienced a 12% increase in deductible and a 5% increase in premiums. In Florida, Utah and Wyoming, premiums increased by more than 50%. ****[****FINISH********READING ON WSJ.COM****](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=3841b45be4374757906424d64380fd89&_e=UFB1ktwC0EW6DbYJk-jxsh-_8jemScP2HGDXFK3nQ4lyqibpuDSGqOgQTwmXmOpBxC3LXvfcsIT-px7Nz9HO_u8Dx0PnkTsCxcLdttcyU6E2KnISK_FLoUthIhdfGZyQtgN3lC0IxoHFErysy09jMcFoANdj913T_ySMhYxXI7I_P7a92FcOAVyEN9uSGqLrnKYHW382Qfzir18765QC07QTVntjydit405WWtAgW3bV4SdH6SMu1-dLaSP5K2cxWC68oqsHZRlHqBsbCyRjBDFQOnSrjJs4nqKDdPFUoptFgINBKg10L1mi7NtgQ9WlAq6G70ZIJCxZzx-WoW2Zvw%3D%3D)****

clean_body: | | | Voter ID laws are ineffective as a means of combating extremely uncommon voter fraud. They are designed to suppress the right to vote. Restrictive voter ID laws have disenfranchised minority voters since the Jim Crow era. They disproportionately impact Black, Native, elderly, and student voters and fail to address election integrity issues. They were designed to enable white legislators to maintain their power. After a record voter turnout in 2020, Georgia’s Republican governor signed a wide-ranging bill that targets minority voters with stunning accuracy. Among other things, it requires a state issued photo ID rather than comparing signatures, addresses, and registration information. Senator John Ossoff (D-GA) has introduced the Right to Vote Act to protect all eligible voters from suppressive voter ID laws. Cedar Key Progress is working year-round to elect Democrats in the South who will fight to stop voter suppression and protect the right to vote! | Photo IDs aren’t as common as many people assume: of all seniors, Latino voters, low-income, and Black voters don’t have an acceptable photo ID due to lack of financial resources, mobility issues, or geographic isolation. People who have changed their name due to marriage or divorce are often turned away from the polls if they don’t have the permissible ID that reflects their name on the voter rolls. Protecting everyone’s right to vote should not be a partisan issue! Voting is the one time when all eligible Americans have an equal say in our government. Not having a photo ID shouldn’t be a reason to deny someone their sacred right to vote!** Thanks for your support. -Cedar Key Progress Cedar Key Progress support Democrats in competitive Southern districts who are building a diverse, inclusive, and just future. | Dear Friends and Neighbors,

As a two-decade veteran of military intelligence, I know that American weakness leads to chaos and tragedy. And let me tell you. Our world is on fire.
* Our botched withdrawal from Afghanistan strengthened our enemies and resulted in American deaths.
* Our waffling on Russia emboldened Vladimir Putin to attack Ukraine.
* Our appeasement of Iran enabled Hamas to slaughter innocent civilians, Houthis to attack American interests, and militias to kill American troops.
* China is harassing our allies, threatening Taiwan, and stealing our secrets.
* Foreign hackers are compromising our critical infrastructure.
* Traffickers are moving illegal immigrants, terrorists, and drugs across our borders.
* Fighting is breaking out in South America, Central Asia, Haiti, and Africa.

This is the price we pay for American weakness.

My GOP primary opponents have no answer. They just repeat cheap slogans and shallow talking points. None of them have any military experience.

Susan Wild doesn’t either. She and her fellow Washington Democrats are making us less safe every day with their indecision, naivety, and cowardice.

You are about to send somebody to Congress to tackle the most dangerous national security matters our country has faced since the height of the Cold War.

I have military experience as an infantry soldier, intelligence officer, and squadron commander. I’ve served overseas in the combat zone and protected our homeland right here in Pennsylvania. And I’ve earned the support of the four largest local police organizations in the Lehigh Valley. I understand what we're up against, and how to defend our freedoms.

Make no mistake. Our enemies are trying to kill us. And they are getting stronger by the day. The only way to keep us safe is through a strong military that strikes fear into the hearts of our enemies and deters them from challenging American power.

That’s peace through strength. It’s what our country lacks today. And it’s what I’ll bring to Congress.

**Keep America Free.**

_Kevin Dellicker is a Republican from Heidelberg Township, Lehigh County, running for U.S. House of Representatives in Pa.’s 7th District. He is a 28-year military veteran, technology company owner, husband and father. He’s not a career politician. He’s a proven leader with the experience and courage to Keep America Free. Learn more at[www.dellickerforcongress.com](https://dellickerforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=2bced6f51ed1caf3f5b731ec5&id=7d57b46683&e=1090c5c412)._

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
Derek, I am incredibly disappointed.
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.
As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.
It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.
If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.
I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

Unlike Governor Youngkin, I will support gun violence prevention laws that keep our families, our children, and our law enforcement officers safe.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82697703/466087456/-735451230?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-04-09_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYjIzN2IwOWUtYjBmNi1lZTExLWFhZjAtN2MxZTUyMDE3MDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=o8EY8O0xMQgOhrSvFO6sBSoYOWyCuMHU83_wXNRtX9E=)
