Peter,

Governor Glenn Youngkin has vetoed 30 gun-related bills, including one banning the sale of assault-style weapons.

But it’s not just that veto that stands in the way of us protecting our communities. He vetoed bills that – based on data – would meaningfully reduce gun violence and the risk of gun violence across Virginia. \- Our legislature passed a bill that would impose civil penalties on someone who leaves a gun unattended and visible in a vehicle. He vetoed it. \- Our legislature voted to implement a five-day waiting period on gun purchases. He vetoed it. \- Our legislature voted to restrict the sale of certain large-capacity magazines. He vetoed it. \- Our legislature voted to prohibit the open carry of specific semi-automatic rifles and shotguns in certain public places. He vetoed it. \- Our legislature voted to create safe storage requirements for guns in homes with minors or individuals not legally allowed to possess firearms. He vetoed it. He vetoed bills that would have made significant progress in protecting Virginians from gun violence while protecting and promoting responsible gun ownership.

Every day, we grapple with the tragic consequences of gun violence. Communities are scarred, families are shattered, and too many lives are lost. But we are not powerless in the face of this crisis.

In Congress, I have tirelessly worked to find common ground on this issue and move common-sense gun violence prevention legislation forward. I proudly stand as a cosponsor of the Assault Weapons Ban, which aims to reinstate the vital protections that were in place from 1994 to 2004, and I have twice voted in support of the Enhanced Background Checks Act. I also worked to move the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act forward — which President Biden signed into law as the first major gun violence prevention law in a generation.

**Unlike Governor Youngkin, I will support gun violence prevention laws that keep our families, our children, and our law enforcement officers safe.**

clean_body: | Folks, we’re fed up. The Arizona Supreme Court just upheld a Civil War-era law that bans abortion in nearly all circumstances. This law is 160 years old and was passed before Arizona was officially a state and before women had the right to vote. Right-wing extremists are so determined to take away basic rights to privacy and bodily autonomy that they’re willing to ignore the needs of actual living people. We’re not going to rest until young voters, in Arizona and beyond, have the tools they need to fight back against extremism. But to do that, we’re going to need your help. So we have to ask: | | If you’re upset or afraid after this ruling, we’re right there with you. Upholding this law from 160 years ago will do nothing but roll back the clock on our rights. And if we’re being honest, this constant fighting over what should be an inherent right is exhausting. But we can’t let up for even one second if we want to protect abortion access nationwide. | | We couldn’t do this without you, NextGen PAC | Paid for by NextGen Climate Action Committee; ; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. | = |

body:
The day 13 Americans were vaporized at the entrance to the Kabul airport was the first time I’d ever considered serving in government again | [](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncUtwbl-QdRXortNTJ2a5hEYjhNOCcBIJ5ZJacnzaPiEVQO31s4hdMLjG6toXJlLpiXVGnUi0PEbrBzXw-E6VyRlz0qX45lHyt1TD32rOnl5M79RINwr0ho4Pd1VqU3bHQcZBaWLw9O2x-G1fGW3HiTM8jSHhNzAxna-kw3LK6IkA%3D)

---
Fellow Conservative,

As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams.

Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, **those are the traits that define me**. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to **[launch a campaign for the United States Senate last June.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncz9H8I1E4a4GArvXA_3fE-Mc4LzX8VLGszFk1FXNlwyi7rlDvz765QsFagUO7MUSJYrE3-QEcdeuQtLWkCpfYVaMp0wRtqC1izlYW4V5_lmiJTqq7QzOOUvkzU4LEQzgZgm0K6EBV1Pi5oLDPqfO84XvK2AGsZGjf19bPTpIhcD8%3D)**

In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [_**many veterans like me**_] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally **sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport** so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead.

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncT053kYnRPXzCItaWLuu5vMDzhZ7Ot9JBeeLtyvBN3-VE-KHDH0VwHTejfjQZIMVs6GXsY7lXBd0rq67kPm5gDtyS2EVMaClz-GomRXUHhUR9nq7FjCUkI8y7Zeu68gJPILH300WkkmzO8mtLaCJOOX9RGttNlH4u9tjRZyW2EcQ%3D)
This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, _**“I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’”**_

Every day it got worse.
Every day it was a disaster.
The adult in the room never materialized.

**Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport.** Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.”

I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. _**So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt**_ because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil.

**If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right.** If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, **[please do me a quick favor and confirm that I have the correct information on file for you](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oarHqy_FLSncDgLxwj9BlLFZS2YQtU3Fbf-fY4kgIkcXsgnzVWvICcc1JfGOxDjzxbOpTvVYAaOZzhE9Ko3wRVfYLbR0wxklZEa1c-CQnOlt5mWCPZCWPAjDkNMvg58nc_DIDS0PIQyDc3YgKpwpmdUiHzmo8nE93EJWjJrJ6AnedYD1NjwQVM3DTdr1F2QAtKbNWgpOGZq_CyF7nVevhtH2o2jgvKip-ShUnDOacb-QYhMmOdJxelKDWpr5l91ecvnTBlJpzztkvYihkW0ezV4CmDC7PF3sK_6aXE4uqi8F2rAnA60Ghq3FVyVq9Z3HcdolDEd8vx_LovkAu0QihcWkp0HHDdpbD3fATneKsrv3k%3D)** ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy.

[**JOIN OUR FIGHT
ENLIST WITH TIM TODAY->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncwgY6FSd-NqGEwwzeNTveDUZwYT1gSnqvSI1xjcuXqCNooH7nKHw7L2OeJbh6ShErqI9OIlV7zAxMhGzI6p4QVqJA90LQgijpx6i34h6ExbCHix-RrPcuWM2rBwhVPOQMDyjOGILACBwrbDFrYw8blaV_Glex-WJCvXPBil_exAs%3D)

It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; **but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. **

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncaoFiaFbCdhhwWDxjSQJmTfvSKYa-mn0bEaONXWcuvljZzBSAJ_vpN3rnopv7UYbnBTjnDiwyEjDqL6bz8rRN7wBUf_d2HctGjkLNELwnJmNzP60_D38tbWT6shSzkf9MShTnUHwMBHwDHT1TAycI9r_G_10u3cmy8BoGhOgBUgY%3D)
**Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield.** I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. [**ENLIST WITH TIM
CONFIRM YOUR SUPPORT TODAY->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRnc-esSMYQzmgIMETil-pPqHaEWNMM0Jx_ESISkFo8UbcfOVkaD-9BJUCf-s3x_N6P4Sdi56ltl-xIuGm8RWK5yGw7YkAj9ZhTjkeujHcvjJiswdN-Q9pA3XYeLzX0VZIVhnIDYyemvcXAy8NZWYXjo0tpXNpWuyA1Ffg-ntdcp8jw%3D)

I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, **[I’m going to need the help of every conservative donor who reads this letter.](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncdKo_wwVtpnQKrkrPkmvoh0_6_LWgRk9ql4n86PihMMT1SQGDtao7Tsnr7uQjeF4Ozs7IBTMozI_tVIBCLLEreeLiEETEzgrHU8ILXPLQwNigAmXtTv2lBf1LAhl5lT0HSaNxztoQrTdcav-sbekj3r7lpzyg9-ZKel1WznHfDec%3D) **

Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes.

We fought in Iraq, _**I was there.**_ We fought in Afghanistan, _**I was there.**_

And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times.

I want to look at my children and tell them, _**“Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.”**_

[](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRnczxgeCdmpy_lXz8xOsmv6M6_KMCTkRiJ9H73iZIUTax1hrjf6ZxTD1PkLrt9F2YN0i7l5yHtvNLACWYwlePoC86tMK1pQ6iyojVc3P8UWx3IY1DPy1tucRc0Ov3YEowD03grxU4gRiclvoXw53yKl-Dr1sIdk9H8PkJBXbNL1KqM%3D)
**But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it.**

So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain.

[**HELP ME FLIP THIS SEAT
ELECT A FIGHTER TO THE U.S. SENATE->** ](http://links.ourdefenseofamerica.com/u/click?_t=aa3ef0db03454a26b650c9ca7e919386&_m=2ea8d9d91c084802b6a9930754dc3281&_e=K_ABfiI6mI3W702EKTTWIuQbAvvuItiQ7tEc400Yng8z_OHNbSJXWpYpVfNSj-oa7WOnDqK50lw2IL3euoN7NF5uxpt5YXAaXJl8CaE5I-Lqu27Kc6DS3m5MP0V3tn11iQnM-tEqfyjyUNlnyfZFCxgnORoW_VhMOjZgDJRuODxp2gg3PAZk5SOjsxeJD_a41KMwRb9FeEmwyV4XRbDXboV5U3th49koj4zOErFwlj34J91TDMGu2PKPJffatRncKXxppdoNvjztkvEejJekWiLQsit87bnem_oezPD77lcTBKsmMznUIWcfbXy6o_URnDFriOrpPgi-4fKUmuq8jLHFP4k37HdDojw-RsYC4utM7QL6E2Oj-3DNoE_QgWfGlVj26FYJFHgEZiNi9YQV6jOp8sUXUqUOpLPbCh_jrOs%3D)

clean_body: The day 13 Americans were vaporized at the entrance to the Kabul airport was the first time I’d ever considered serving in government again | Fellow Conservative, As a former Navy SEAL and combat veteran, I’ve seen my fair share of battle. Between my and my wife’s service to our country, we’ve sacrificed years of our lives to make America a more safe and prosperous nation and to protect our God-given freedoms and liberties. We served so that our children and yours might grow up to realize their own American Dreams. Duty to country. Service and sacrifice over self, those are the traits that define me. I’m proud of the work we did for our country. That said, the events of August 2021 rocked me to my core and ultimately led me to In August 2021, I was putting out wildfires in California by day as part of the aerial firefighting company that I run; by night, my colleagues [many veterans like me] and I were working the phones trying to get our friends and allies out of Afghanistan before the takeover by the Taliban. I remember vividly that at one point I was trying to help an ally sneak through a tunnel to get him and his family to the airport so that they could be evacuated on a U.S. military aircraft. The Taliban wanted these high-value targets dead; they wanted their families dead. This continued for days. Throughout the entire process, “I kept thinking to myself, “The adult will come in the room and say, ‘Hey, this is a disaster; we’re going to stop this.’” Every day it got worse. Every day it was a disaster. The adult in the room never materialized. Then, 13 Americans were vaporized at the gate to Kabul’s airport. Billions of dollars in military and human assets were left behind – all so Joe Biden could get a press conference saying that he’d pulled the country out of an “endless war.” I had sat in the homes of the families that we were frantically trying to get out; I had promised them that we weren’t going to leave them behind. So, you can imagine the dishonor that I felt because of the promises we weren’t able to keep to the people who’d sacrificed so much to help us combat evil. If you're thinking this email is on the longer side, you're right. If you're short on time and unable to finish reading to the end right now, ; my opponent and his allies will not make winning this seat easy. It was in the aftermath of the fall of Afghanistan that I ever truly considered entering politics. Deciding to launch a campaign for the United States Senate wasn’t an easy decision; but the United States needs leaders who understand the sacrifice it’s taken to build our country. When your country calls and needs you, you have to answer. Unlike Joe Biden, I understand what it is to serve our country. Not service in politics, but on the battlefield. I’ve been wounded in service of our nation; I’ve lost mentors and friends who were willing to make the ultimate sacrifice so that future generations will be free. I’m reaching out to you today because if this campaign to flip Montana’s U.S. Senate seat is going to be successful, Twice in a row, Joe Biden has pulled us out of two wars for political purposes. We fought in Iraq, I was there. We fought in Afghanistan, I was there. And each time, for political purposes, Biden pulled out our forces and damaged our nation’s reputation in the process. And my opponent in the Senate race, Democrat Jon Tester, supported Biden both times. I want to look at my children and tell them, “Yes, you should serve your country, as your mom and dad did. Your parents put on the uniform; you should do the same.” But when we have a president who is willing to pull the plug on a whim for political purposes, it’s hard to tell future generations the sacrifices in service of God and country will be worth it. So, Fellow Conservative \- that’s what I’m fighting for. I’m fighting to restore faith in our American way of life. I entered the political arena to ensure the sacrifices my friends made weren’t made in vain. For America's Future, Tim Sheehy Former Navy SEAL Republican Candidate for U.S. Senate | " "I SERVED AS A NAVY SEAL, BUILT ONE OF THE LARGEST AERIAL FIREFIGHTING COMPANIES IN AMERICA CREATING OVER 200 MONTANA JOBS, AND STARTED A VETERAN-LED CATTLE RANCHING AND FEEDING OPERATION. WHETHER IT WAS IN WAR OR BUSINESS, I SEE PROBLEMS AND SOLVE THEM. AMERICA NEEDS CONSERVATIVE LEADERS WHO LOVE OUR COUNTRY. I'M RUNNING FOR THE U.S. SENATE BECAUSE OUR CAMPAIGN IS ABOUT SERVICE, DUTY, AND COUNTRY -- NOT POLITICS AS USUAL." | | PAID FOR BY TIM SHEEHY FOR MONTANA Tim Sheehy is a former Navy SEAL. Portland is shaking things up.

| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82698140/466089057/1328794144?refcode=ea.b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIzN2E3YmMwLWIyZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=m2RcGtKGUPj5QFaKdbHLlz8Y4Xn2Y63jR98RVJc1iWk=&emci=bf91cfef-9df6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&emdi=b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ceid=4823105)

We’re going to cover a lot of ground in this email, but if you’re strapped for time, here’s the short version: _**First: this November is Portland, Oregon’s first election under its new charter and the whole city council is up for grabs.**_ _**Second: that, combined with Portland’s Small Donor Election program, presents an opportunity to finally elect committed climate champions to the council.**_ _**Third: we’re adding Steph Routh to our slate of Portland City Council Candidates.**_ If you’re a Portland resident, please make a contribution to support her campaign today and take advantage of the city’s public match program. If not, please contribute anyway; your support will still go a long way in the race. | [**CONTRIBUTE**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82698141/466089058/-749075275?refcode=ea.b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIzN2E3YmMwLWIyZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=m2RcGtKGUPj5QFaKdbHLlz8Y4Xn2Y63jR98RVJc1iWk=)

**Here’s the longer version.** We usually try not to overload our subscribers with a lot of unnecessary detail in these emails, but it is important to us that you know as much as possible about why we’re asking for your support, so please bear with us for a bit of wonkiness.
The 2024 Portland City Council elections mark a huge overhaul of the city's governance and electoral system. They’re moving away from a city commission government with a five-member board which includes the mayor, to a structure where the mayor is no longer part of the city council. Instead, the council will expand to 12 total seats, divided up by 4 districts, with 3 council members representing each district.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/82698142/466089059/-749075275?refcode=ea.b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&ms=ea.b37a7bc0-b2f6-ee11-aaf0-7c1e52017038&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImIzN2E3YmMwLWIyZjYtZWUxMS1hYWYwLTdjMWU1MjAxNzAzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=m2RcGtKGUPj5QFaKdbHLlz8Y4Xn2Y63jR98RVJc1iWk=)
Additionally, council members will now be elected via “proportional ranked-choice voting,” without a primary. With every seat up for grabs, this presents an incredible opportunity to upgrade the city council across the board, and to finally elect some brave climate champions to city council.
You may have noticed in our previous emails about Portland that we’ve emphasized how important “small dollar” contributions are, especially from Portland residents. Here’s why — Portland’s Small Donor Election fund will match $20 of every _eligible contribution_ 9-to-1, potentially _up to $120,000 for qualified candidates._ Specifically:
* _Contributions are eligible_ for these matching funds as long as they are over $5, and come from an individual Portland resident over 18 years old.
* Candidates may unlock the matching funds in three separate tiers. A total of 250 donors can unlock up to $40,000, a total of 750 qualifying donors can unlock up to another $80,000 and a total of 1,250 qualifying donors can unlock the final round of matching funds, of up to a final $120,000.

With this context in mind, here’s our ask: whether you live in Portland or across the country, will you make a contribution to support Steph Routh’s campaign today?

The 2024 Portland City Council elections mark a huge overhaul of the city's governance and electoral system. They’re moving away from a city commission government with a five-member board which includes the mayor, to a structure where the mayor is no longer part of the city council. Instead, the council will expand to 12 total seats, divided up by 4 districts, with 3 council members representing each district. = Additionally, council members will now be elected via “proportional ranked-choice voting,” without a primary. With every seat up for grabs, this presents an incredible opportunity to upgrade the city council across the board, and to finally elect some brave climate champions to city council. You may have noticed in our previous emails about Portland that we’ve emphasized how important “small dollar” contributions are, especially from Portland residents. Here’s why — Portland’s Small Donor Election fund will match $20 of every eligible contribution 9-to-1, potentially up to $120,000 for qualified candidates. | Peter,

I came to Congress to fight for the issues that matter most to families and workers in the Lehigh Valley and across the nation — starting with standing up to the pharmaceutical industry to ensure that prescription drugs are safe, affordable, and accessible.

**I’ve been fighting against Big Pharma since I got to Congress,_and I’m not stopping now._**

I was proud to stand with President Biden and Democrats in passing the Inflation Reduction Act, which allowed us to cap insulin copays at $35 per month for Americans on Medicare.

name: Kevin Lincoln
subject: Send a Marine to the House
disclaimer_text:

KEVIN LINCOLN FOR CONGRESS<-
body:
Fellow American,

As a Marine, I’ve faced a lot of challenges on behalf of our country.

In the Marine Corps, I always had others at my side...

-> ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4457248.1966.1.dd8eb4cd2c1666acd365bf16a337ea4a )<-

The fight I’m engaged in now for our country is a whole other kind of challenge.

In _this_ fight to win \*\*battleground House seat CA-9\*\* and protect a GOP majority that can get our nation back on track, \*\*it’s you I need by my side.\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4457248.1967.1.ab7245363318f96bb365b25706b21a10 )

- Deadly fentanyl pours over our open borders.

- High inflation on everything from food to fuel continues to plague American families.

- Woke agendas displace American values.

- Criminals receive deference, and law enforcement is demonized.

- The needs of other nations are placed ahead of those of our own people.

\*\*As a Marine Corps veteran, and as a local Mayor, I need your help to flip this seat and get to Congress so we have leaders in Washington who will fight for THIS country and ITS people.\*\*

Our Republican House majority hangs by a thread, and adding this seat will strengthen our ability to stand up to and stop the radical agendas being pushed by D.C. politicians and bureaucrats.

\*\*Congress needs more Marines. Will you please stand with me and rush any support you can today to help us win this seat, protect the House, and ensure America has leaders who will fight for us FIRST?\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4457248.1968.1.c8e5ee5a313d229b2737b7e30e5ee84f )

Thank you,

\*\*Kevin Lincoln\*\*

Veteran, USMC

GOP Nominee, CA-9

-> \*\*SEND A MARINE TO CONGRESS »\*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4457248.1969.1.a15e1f9b03340d5c4ee95c03962665bc )<-

->

->\*\*Meet Kevin Lincoln

\*\*<-

My name is Kevin Lincoln, and my story, is the Valley’s story. I am a 3rd generation Stocktonian, raising a 4th generation in the city I love. I’m the grandson of Mexican immigrants, and my stepfather is an Army veteran.

Like many Stocktonians, my family has overcome economic setbacks. My own father struggled to survive on these streets, and was at one time, homeless. But I never let adversity define me. I joined the Marines and served in the White House Military Office, assigned to Marine One. I graduated college while working full-time and raising a family. I’ve worked in corporate America and served our community as a pastor, and as a non-profit leader.

I’m blessed with a beautiful wife, Bonnie, and two amazing children. I’ve lived a life of service, but the greatest honor of my life has been giving back to my community, through serving as Mayor of my hometown, Stockton.

-> \*\* SEND KEVIN TO CONGRESS ➞ \*\* ( https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/38066?id=4457248.1970.1.ad274e89721832b3b2551104cde5340c )<-

name: Chuck Morse
subject: Today I released my plan to fortify Granite State defenses
body:
Together we can combat deadly drugs, crime, and unlawful border crossings in the 603
| |
---
**I am thrilled to share a pivotal moment from our campaign journey, one that underscores my commitment to ensuring the safety and prosperity of our cherished Granite State. Today, alongside esteemed leaders from both the State Senate and House, I unveiled a comprehensive plan designed to tackle the urgent issues of deadly drugs, crime, and unlawful border crossings facing our communities.** **The gravity of our mission cannot be overstated. Under the current administration, every state has effectively become a border state, with our federal government failing to take decisive action to protect families in New Hampshire.** **Border Patrol estimates reveal a staggering truth: over ten million illegal immigrants have crossed our southern border since Joe Biden assumed office—surpassing the entire population of New Hampshire. Here in the Granite State, we've keenly felt the repercussions of this crisis. Mexican drug cartels exploit our nation's lax immigration laws, flooding our communities with deadly narcotics like Fentanyl. The toll is staggering, with nearly 400 opioid-related overdose deaths annually, two-thirds of which involve Fentanyl or other synthetic drugs.** **As your next Governor, I stand resolved to confront this crisis head-on. I am determined to be the unwavering voice that defends our families and our future. I encourage you to sign up and support our plan below!** **\- Chuck Morse**

Sadly, this is not just one of Trump’s bald-faced lies. In 2016, Donald Trump ran for president promising to appoint a Supreme Court that would overturn Roe v. Wade. Once he got into office, that’s exactly what he did.

We know that Trump refuses to stand with women in the United States, and has no respect for the fundamental right to reproductive health care.

President Biden and Vice President Harris believe that reproductive healthcare decisions should be between women and their doctors, not politicians or the government.

We stand with the President and Vice President and know that women’s healthcare choices should not be decided by President Trump and his far-right-appointed Supreme Court.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born. |

Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

**No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.**

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster if that’s what it takes.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

| | | Friend,

I can't explain how grateful I am that you chose to read this email. Only about 30-40% of folks open these messages, and look I get it - there are a lot of political emails being sent these days.

Unfortunately, I rely on emails, texts, mail, and phone calls to stay in touch with conservatives like you.

**With that being said, could you do me the simple favor of just reading this all the way through to the end?** If you get to the end and still don't think you have the power to make a difference, then I just want to thank you for your time.

While roughly 35% of supporters open these messages, only an average of 1% of supporters will step up to donate, which makes it difficult since I rely on Americans like you receiving this message to hit my fundraising goals.

I refuse to rely on billionaires and Wall Street executives for money. I want our conservative values fueled by the people who believe in them most - you and me.

**And you know what?** If everyone who opened this email gave just $1 - __one single dollar__ - we'd be able to hit all of our goals.

✅ Polling is one of the criteria used to determine whether or not to grant a presidential candidate Secret Service protection.
✅ Recent polls show that 50 million Americans would vote for me.

body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.
| | |
---
Team, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.
No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.
It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by _Roe v. Wade_ the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

#
Peter, one of my proudest moments in Congress might not be one that you'd expect.
I'd like to tell you more about this, but if you're ready to close out of your email for the day, before you do, **[can I ask you to chip in $10 to help us protect our Democratic Senate majority?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82701569/466101013/-1447414995?&amount=10&source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.04.09_B1_Airplanes_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Njk1ZDFjMy1iZGY2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Tk1El9rS0IQVjd5iNV13FzQeWV86NCovELZHmy4oH1c=)**
**[CHIP IN $10 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/82701570/466101014/-1447414995?&amount=10&source=LOC_EM_FR_2024.04.09_B1_Airplanes_Actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5Njk1ZDFjMy1iZGY2LWVlMTEtYWFmMC03YzFlNTIwMTcwMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Tk1El9rS0IQVjd5iNV13FzQeWV86NCovELZHmy4oH1c=)**
In 1987, at the beginning of my third term as representative, my office drafted and passed landmark legislation that banned smoking on short domestic flights. Two years later, this law applied to all domestic flights.
On its face, this may seem like a trivial thing to herald as one of my proudest moments, but it had significant personal meaning to me. When I was 14, I lost my dad to lung cancer. He was only 53. I knew that no family should have to experience the loss that we did.
Even if you weren't a smoker, studies pointed to the negative effects of secondhand smoke in confined spaces. I'm proud that my legislation began the movement to ban smoking in public places like hospitals, schools, and restaurants. The Big Tobacco industry fought us hard, but we won.
Throughout my career, I've put the well-being of folks in Illinois and across the country first. I know that this election is no different.

subject: What are your priorities for a better Georgia, Peter?

body:
Peter
There’s a lot at stake in 2024 – Georgia House Democrats are going on offense to reclaim a Democratic Majority in the House and continue the fight to build a better Georgia for us all.
House Democrats are fighting hard for an agenda that ensures every Georgian has access to healthcare, a world-class education, affordable housing, and a good job. Will you join us in this fight and share your priorities for a better Georgia? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/lzNLTYfKPUmhfSa7JqA0PA2]
Take our survey >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/lzNLTYfKPUmhfSa7JqA0PA2]
Under the Gold Dome, Georgia Republicans are continuing their extreme attacks on working families across the state. Meanwhile, House Democrats are laser-focused on an agenda that puts people before politics.
We’re fighting to ensure that all Georgians have the ability to achieve their American Dream. We’re fighting for access to affordable healthcare, a world-class education for our children, a pathway to home ownership, and adequate care for our state’s aging population.
We’ve talked to Georgians all over the state, but we would love to hear what issues are on the ballot for you in 2024, Peter.
Share your priorities for a better Georgia with Georgia House Democrats by taking our official 2024 Priorities Survey >> [https://secure.ngpvan.com/lzNLTYfKPUmhfSa7JqA0PA2]
We cannot thank you enough for your support of our mission, and we look forward to fighting alongside you to reclaim power for the people and retake a Democratic Majority in the Georgia House.
Georgia House Democrats
OUR AGENDA
Every day, we're fighting for a better Georgia for hard-working families like yours. To learn more, visit us here [https://gahousedems.com/agenda/?refcode=email-footer-agenda] .
HEALTHCARE: We must expand Medicaid to keep our hospitals open and ensure every Georgian can see a doctor when they're sick. PUBLIC SAFETY: ABORTION ACCESS: PUBLIC EDUCATION:
We can save lives by passing universal background checks, safe storage laws, and waiting periods. We're fighting to overturn Georgia's six-week abortion ban and restore reproductive freedom to all Georgians. We must invest in Georgia's teachers and fully fund every public school, regardless of zip code.

name: Carmen Goers
subject: Standing Together on National Former Prisoner of War Recognition Day
body:
Join the Team

| | | | | | | |
---
| | | |
---
| | | **Standing Together on National Former POW Recognition Day**
---

Dear Peter,
Today, on National Former Prisoner of War Recognition Day, we pause to honor and remember the courage and resilience of those who were held captive and returned to us. Their extraordinary sacrifices in the face of unimaginable challenges embody the spirit of heroism and perseverance.
My campaign is committed to ensuring that our nation's heroes, including former prisoners of war, receive the respect, honor, and support they deserve. Our dedication to veteran affairs and military families in Washington's 8th district is unwavering.

---
| | | |
---
| In observance of this significant day, we're reaching out to ask for your support. By donating to our campaign, you're not just contributing to a political cause; you're helping to champion the needs and rights of our veterans and their families.

A contribution of $25, $50, or $100 will directly support efforts to advocate for policies that ensure our veterans have access to the healthcare, support services, and recognition they've earned.

---
| [ DONATE TODAY! ](https://vgq.soundestlink.com/link/6615be22c94df1b1ee202b71/6614428d28ed0ef7c5a528d6/652845d9aa222127cf458b43?signature=2300d4fc1794c1641739c6ec1ac8f09d8399396a179bde5871bacadba4875dd2)
---
| | | Let us come together to honor the bravery of our former prisoners of war by ensuring their sacrifices are never forgotten and their needs are always met.
Thank you for your generosity and for standing with our heroes.

With gratitude,

Carmen Goers

body:
No person should have to go into lifelong debt in order to get an education.
#
Student loan debt in our country now totals $1.77 billion, a moral hazard that impacts over 40 million borrowers.
Yesterday, President Biden unveiled a new plan to offer complete or partial relief to over 25 million of them — **including a category Alexandria personally fought to include: borrowers experiencing undue financial hardship from significant medical expenses, childcare expenses, skyrocketing cost of living, and more.**
This is huge.
This brings hope for people to buy a house, or have a kid, or travel abroad, or maybe even go back to school and pursue a career that they otherwise wouldn’t have.
**No person should have to go into lifelong debt in order to get an education.**
[And thanks to small-dollar support, Alexandria can spend all of her time fighting for life-changing, progressive legislation like debt cancellation, instead of making calls to wealthy donors to fund this campaign. Will you make a $3 contribution today to support Alexandia’s fight for policies that actually improve working people’s lives?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240409.VRJfBl&refcode=em20240409-6161-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=6161%2E2526796%2EhRSioF)
**[Contribute $3](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20240409.VRJfBl&refcode=em20240409-6161-P_FND_CTR_HDL&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=6161%2E2526796%2EhRSioF)**
Student debt cancellation is a racial justice issue. Black and Latino borrowers are 3 times more likely to default on student loan payments than their white peers. If passed as proposed, the new plan would help remove barriers to equity and stability for millions of working families across the country as soon as this fall.
Together we can keep up the pressure on President Biden to not only do what’s in the best interest of our nation’s economy, but also what is morally right: **cancel student loan debt permanently**.
In solidarity,
Team AOC

clean_body: No person should have to go into lifelong debt in order to get an education. Student loan debt in our country now totals $1.77 billion, a moral hazard that impacts over 40 million borrowers. Yesterday, President Biden unveiled a new plan to offer complete or partial relief to over 25 million of them — including a category Alexandria personally fought to include: borrowers experiencing undue financial hardship from significant medical expenses, childcare expenses, skyrocketing cost of living, and more. This is huge. This brings hope for people to buy a house, or have a kid, or travel abroad, or maybe even go back to school and pursue a career that they otherwise wouldn’t have. No person should have to go into lifelong debt in order to get an education. Student debt cancellation is a racial justice issue. Black and Latino borrowers are 3 times more likely to default on student loan payments than their white peers. If passed as proposed, the new plan would help remove barriers to equity and stability for millions of working families across the country as soon as this fall. Together we can keep up the pressure on President Biden to not only do what’s in the best interest of our nation’s economy, but also what is morally right: cancel student loan debt permanently. In solidarity, Team AOC | ---|--- | | ---|---|--- Email us: mailto: speak@ocasiocortez.com

body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

| Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

And here’s how it works

Peter, Last month, the Supreme Court heard oral arguments in a case concerning mifepristone, a safe, at-home abortion medication widely used by people seeking reproductive care. **Let’s recall how we got here.** Before this case was brought to the Supreme Court, anti-choice activists intentionally brought their case to the courtroom of Judge Matthew Kacsmaryk — a right-wing Trump appointee — to ensure he’d decide it. They wanted mifepristone banned nationwide, and in his courtroom, they knew they’d have a shot. This practice of “judge shopping,” where partisan activists hand-pick judges to set nationwide policy, deeply undermines the integrity of our federal judiciary. Judge shopping has been used to influence national decisions related to immigration, access to health care, and LGBTQ+ rights. **And that’s why Mazie has a bill to end it.** Mazie’s _Stop Judge Shopping Act_ would give the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia — which impartially hears and decides the large majority of cases involving challenges to federal agency actions — sole authority over cases with nationwide implications. This means that cases would be decided by the law, not by ideologically-motivated judges. Judge shopping has been used to influence national decisions related to immigration, access to health care, and LGBTQ+ rights. And that’s why Mazie has a bill to end it. Mazie’s Stop Judge Shopping Act would give the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia — which impartially hears and decides the large majority of cases involving challenges to federal agency actions — sole authority over cases with nationwide implications. The Arizona Supreme Court reached a decision today that will lead to a complete ban on abortion in our state.
A law was passed in 1864 — during the Civil War, before Arizona was a state, before women could even vote — that completely bans abortion with no exceptions for rape or incest.
The Arizona Supreme Court decided that this 160 year old law is enforceable.

“I am incredibly thrilled that we are going to have a great law that’s already on the books.”

body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

| Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

subject: Let's Go Team GB3 for Congress!!!
body:
Hello Team!

My first message to you has been a long time coming, but I am so excited to
finish this campaign out strong! *Please read through.*

We have come *so far because of YOU!* Monday morning it was shared with me
that in two recent polls, *OUR CAMPAIGN was in the TOP 4!?! *This was
humbling and exhilarating because I thought it qualified me to be in next
week's "Frontrunners" debate (based on what a WANE TV representative had
told me).

Then last night, the debate field was set with the top 4 fundraisers... You
can read the article here
<https://www.wane.com/news/your-local-election-hq/four-candidate-gop-primary-debate-set-for-in3/>
.

But take heart! HARD WORK, COMMUNITY SUPPORT, GENUINE DISCOURSE, and GOD'S
FAVOR are what have gotten us to this point! We do not need to change that
formula by adding a break from the media to make a strong push to the
finish. What we do need, IS *YOU!*

May 7th is in sight. I ask you to join us in an all out blitz through:

- Telling people, and telling them to tell people...
- Talk, text, call, post, tweet, share, like, love, forward, whisper,
shout, and most importantly, pray!
(I will be sending you a video link to pass along. Feel free to add your
own verbiage for why you believe I would serve your family well in
Congress.)
- Use whatever gifts God has given you to *help get word out*.
- And VOTE! 🇺🇲 *Don't wait until May 7.* You never know what may come
up. You can vote today and spend the rest of the time telling others to get
out there too!

*God has to show up, but may WE do our part to Inspire Renewal in our Land!*

Humbly yours,
Grant

subject: a dark day
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight for Progress PAC and not authorized by any candidate or any candidate's committee
body:
Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born, before even our grandparents were born.

| Peter, I am incredibly disappointed.

Just a little while ago, the Arizona Supreme Court decided to enforce a law from long before any of us were born before even our grandparents were born.

They are enforcing a near-total ban on abortion that was originally passed before Arizona was even a state, in 1864, during the Civil War.

No exceptions for rape. No exceptions for incest.

As a father, I am fearful for my daughter. As an Arizonan, I am fearful for the people of my state. And as an American, I am absolutely furious that this has come to pass.

It’s not lost on me that this happened because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built and because the Senate failed to act to protect abortion rights when they had the chance.

It’s a dark day, but this is **NOT** over.

If I make it to the Senate I will do everything I can to pass legislation that will make the protections provided by Roe v. Wade the law of the land — including reforming the filibuster.

I’m a Marine, and I’ll fight alone if I have to. But we’ll accomplish a lot more together. So please, if you’re looking for a way to channel your anger into action, consider supporting my campaign.

subject: Democracy Summer Fellowship Applications OPEN
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Pramila for Congress
body:
Pramila is looking for dedicated high school juniors and seniors and college students to join us as Pramila for Congress Fellows!
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240409-3733-footer&t=1&akid=3733%2E420207%2EC5ImC4)
Peter, Pramila is about to launch a massive youth voter organizing initiative and we need your support — and any young people who are ready to organize to win!
Team Pramila will be a partner in this year’s 2024 National Democracy Summer School! This unique Democratic Fellowship, founded by Rep. Jamie Raskin, is dedicated to recruiting and training thousands of high school and college-aged students to be the next generation of Democratic political changemakers.
**As a part of this initiative, Pramila is looking for dedicated high school juniors and seniors and college students in her district to join as Pramila for Congress Fellows!**
**This six-week program will allow selected fellows to participate in exciting online seminars and a powerful curriculum, while also organizing on-the-ground with Pramila’s reelection campaign here in WA-07.**[**If you’re interested, or think you know of someone who might be eligible and interested, click here for more information about Democracy Summer.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/48125?t=2&akid=3733%2E420207%2EC5ImC4)
**[Democracy Summer ››](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/48125?t=3&akid=3733%2E420207%2EC5ImC4)**
**If you’re not a student, but you’re excited about helping fund stipends for the incredible interns that will help Pramila organize and win this year,**[**please consider supporting our program by making a donation to the campaign here!**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240409.PQEs9U&refcode=em20240409-3733&t=4&akid=3733%2E420207%2EC5ImC4)

**It takes all of us to lift up the next generation of leaders. Thank you for your support.**
Together,
Team Jayapal
**[Contribute](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pj-email-footer?refcode=em20240409-3733-footer&t=24&refcode2=3733_420207_C5ImC4&akid=3733%2E420207%2EC5ImC4)**
